\* writer must retry: re-read the epoch, then attempt the commit again.

  /\ epoch \in 0..(MaxEpoch-1)
  /\ owner \in Participants \cup {"none"}
  /\ localEpoch \in [Participants -> 0..(MaxEpoch-1)]
  /\ crashed \in [Participants -> BOOLEAN]
  /\ pending \in [Participants -> BOOLEAN]

  /\ epoch = 0
  /\ owner = "none"
  /\ localEpoch = [p \in Participants |-> 0]
  /\ crashed = [p \in Participants |-> FALSE]
  /\ pending = [p \in Participants |-> FALSE]

\* A non-crashed, idle participant submits a scheduling request, stamping it
\* with the epoch it currently observes.
Request(p) ==
  /\ ~crashed[p]
  /\ ~pending[p]
  /\ pending' = [pending EXCEPT ![p] = TRUE]
  /\ localEpoch' = [localEpoch EXCEPT ![p] = epoch]
  /\ UNCHANGED <<epoch, owner, crashed>>

\* Commit only succeeds if the writer's stamp still matches: this is the
\* optimistic-locking check that rejects stale or unauthorized writers.
Commit(p) ==

  /\ pending[p]
  /\ localEpoch[p] = epoch
  /\ epoch' = (epoch + 1) % MaxEpoch
  /\ owner' = p

---------------------------- MODULE W4Od0m8p2t0 ----------------------------
EXTENDS Naturals

CONSTANTS Staff, Rooms, Total, Cap

ASSUME Total \in Nat /\ Total >= 1
ASSUME Cap \in Nat /\ Cap >= 1

None == "none"

VARIABLES
    loc,       \* loc[r] = number of patients in room r
    wardLock,  \* holder of the coarse ward lock, or None
    roomLock,  \* roomLock[r] = holder of room r's fine lock, or None
    crashed    \* set of staff who crashed (at most one)

vars == << loc, wardLock, roomLock, crashed >>

RECURSIVE SumLoc(_)
SumLoc(S) ==
    IF S = {} THEN 0
    ELSE LET r == CHOOSE x \in S : TRUE IN loc[r] + SumLoc(S \ {r})

TypeOK ==
    /\ loc \in [Rooms -> 0..Total]
    /\ wardLock \in Staff \cup {None}
    /\ roomLock \in [Rooms -> Staff \cup {None}]
    /\ crashed \subseteq Staff

Init ==
    /\ loc = [r \in Rooms |-> IF r = CHOOSE x \in Rooms : TRUE THEN Total ELSE 0]
    /\ wardLock = None
    /\ roomLock = [r \in Rooms |-> None]
    /\ crashed = {}

AcquireWard(s) ==
    /\ s \notin crashed
    /\ wardLock = None
    /\ wardLock' = s
    /\ UNCHANGED << loc, roomLock, crashed >>

AcquireRoom(s, r) ==
    /\ wardLock = s
    /\ roomLock[r] = None
    /\ roomLock' = [roomLock EXCEPT ![r] = s]
    /\ UNCHANGED << loc, wardLock, crashed >>

\* The source-room-lock holder transfers one patient to a below-capacity room.
Transfer(s, r1, r2) ==
    /\ roomLock[r1] = s
    /\ r1 # r2
    /\ loc[r1] > 0
    /\ loc[r2] < Cap
    /\ loc' = [loc EXCEPT ![r1] = @ - 1, ![r2] = @ + 1]
    /\ UNCHANGED << wardLock, roomLock, crashed >>

ReleaseRoom(s, r) ==
    /\ roomLock[r] = s
    /\ roomLock' = [roomLock EXCEPT ![r] = None]
    /\ UNCHANGED << loc, wardLock, crashed >>

ReleaseWard(s) ==
    /\ wardLock = s
    /\ \A r \in Rooms : roomLock[r] # s
    /\ wardLock' = None
    /\ UNCHANGED << loc, roomLock, crashed >>

\* A single staff member crashes silently, dropping its held locks.
Crash(s) ==
    /\ crashed = {}
    /\ crashed' = {s}
    /\ wardLock' = IF wardLock = s THEN None ELSE wardLock
    /\ roomLock' = [r \in Rooms |-> IF roomLock[r] = s THEN None ELSE roomLock[r]]
    /\ UNCHANGED loc

Next ==
    \/ \E s \in Staff : AcquireWard(s)
    \/ \E s \in Staff, r \in Rooms : AcquireRoom(s, r)
    \/ \E s \in Staff, r1 \in Rooms, r2 \in Rooms : Transfer(s, r1, r2)
    \/ \E s \in Staff, r \in Rooms : ReleaseRoom(s, r)
    \/ \E s \in Staff : ReleaseWard(s)
    \/ \E s \in Staff : Crash(s)

Spec == Init /\ [][Next]_vars

\* Patients are conserved: the total across all rooms never changes.
Conservation ==
    SumLoc(Rooms) = Total

  /\ board = << >>
  /\ note = [c \in Controllers |-> NoNote]
  /\ rcptAt = [c \in Controllers |-> 0]
  /\ rcptRwy = [c \in Controllers |-> NoReceipt]
  /\ open = Runways

ReadBoard(c) ==
  /\ note[c] = NoNote
  /\ note' = [note EXCEPT ![c] = Len(board)]
  /\ UNCHANGED <<board, rcptAt, rcptRwy, open>>

\* The length match is the compare half of the compare-and-append.
AddStrip(c, r) ==
  /\ note[c] # NoNote
  /\ note[c] = Len(board)
  /\ Len(board) < MaxStrips
  /\ r \in open
  /\ board' = Append(board, r)
  /\ rcptAt' = [rcptAt EXCEPT ![c] = Len(board) + 1]
  /\ rcptRwy' = [rcptRwy EXCEPT ![c] = r]
  /\ note' = [note EXCEPT ![c] = NoNote]
  /\ UNCHANGED open

  /\ (note[c] # Len(board) \/ Len(board) = MaxStrips)

  /\ UNCHANGED <<board, rcptAt, rcptRwy, open>>

Rewrite(i, r) ==

  /\ ~Receipted(i)
  /\ r \in open
  /\ board' = [board EXCEPT ![i] = r]
  /\ UNCHANGED <<note, rcptAt, rcptRwy, open>>

  /\ \A c \in Controllers : rcptAt[c] <= k
  /\ board' = SubSeq(board, 1, k)
  /\ UNCHANGED <<note, rcptAt, rcptRwy, open>>

CloseRunway(r) ==
  /\ r \in open
  /\ open' = open \ {r}
  /\ UNCHANGED <<board, note, rcptAt, rcptRwy>>

  /\ UNCHANGED <<board, note, rcptAt, rcptRwy>>

------------------------------ MODULE W4Od1m1p2t3 ------------------------------
EXTENDS Naturals

CONSTANTS Total, NumControllers

Controllers == 1..NumControllers
NextOf(c) == (c % NumControllers) + 1

VARIABLES token, pool, approaching, circling, stalled

vars == <<token, pool, approaching, circling, stalled>>

TypeOK ==
    /\ token \in Controllers
    /\ pool \in 0..Total
    /\ approaching \in 0..Total
    /\ circling \in 0..Total
    /\ stalled \in [Controllers -> BOOLEAN]

Init ==
    /\ token = 1
    /\ pool = Total
    /\ approaching = 0
    /\ circling = 0
    /\ stalled = [c \in Controllers |-> FALSE]

\* The allocation token holder issues a landing clearance: a credit leaves the
\* free pool and follows an aircraft onto final approach.
Clear ==
    /\ ~ stalled[token]
    /\ pool > 0
    /\ pool' = pool - 1
    /\ approaching' = approaching + 1
    /\ UNCHANGED <<token, circling, stalled>>

\* An aircraft on approach lands and its clearance credit returns to the pool.
Land ==
    /\ ~ stalled[token]
    /\ approaching > 0
    /\ approaching' = approaching - 1
    /\ pool' = pool + 1
    /\ UNCHANGED <<token, circling, stalled>>

\* The holder diverts an approaching aircraft into a holding pattern; its credit
\* moves into the circling set without being lost.
Hold ==
    /\ ~ stalled[token]
    /\ approaching > 0
    /\ approaching' = approaching - 1
    /\ circling' = circling + 1
    /\ UNCHANGED <<token, pool, stalled>>

\* A circling aircraft is brought back onto final approach.
Rejoin ==
    /\ ~ stalled[token]
    /\ circling > 0
    /\ circling' = circling - 1
    /\ approaching' = approaching + 1
    /\ UNCHANGED <<token, pool, stalled>>

\* A controller becomes temporarily slow (heavy workload) -- it is not failed and
\* loses nothing, but it must recover before acting or handing off.
Stall(c) ==
    /\ ~ stalled[c]
    /\ stalled' = [stalled EXCEPT ![c] = TRUE]
    /\ UNCHANGED <<token, pool, approaching, circling>>

Resume(c) ==
    /\ stalled[c]
    /\ stalled' = [stalled EXCEPT ![c] = FALSE]
    /\ UNCHANGED <<token, pool, approaching, circling>>

\* The token is passed to the next controller; a slow (stalled) holder must
\* recover first, so a slow participant delays the ring but never breaks it.
PassToken ==
    /\ ~ stalled[token]
    /\ token' = NextOf(token)
    /\ UNCHANGED <<pool, approaching, circling, stalled>>

Next ==
    \/ Clear
    \/ Land
    \/ Hold
    \/ Rejoin
    \/ \E c \in Controllers : Stall(c)
    \/ \E c \in Controllers : Resume(c)
    \/ PassToken

Spec == Init /\ [][Next]_vars

\* Conservation: every landing-clearance credit is always accounted for in exactly
\* one of the three states -- free in the pool, following an approaching aircraft,
\* or with a circling aircraft -- so the allocator never invents or drops a credit.
Conserved == pool + approaching + circling = Total

---- MODULE W4Od1m7p4t0 ----
EXTENDS Naturals, FiniteSets

\* Controllers admit aircraft to the approach corridor by compare-and-swap
\* on one register holding the admitted count plus a stamp.  A controller
\* may go dark silently between reading the register and swapping it.
CONSTANTS Flights, Controllers, Corridor, MaxStamp

NoFlight == "none"
Fresh == [seen |-> 0, stamp |-> 0, plane |-> NoFlight]

VARIABLES reg, corridor, desk, scratch
vars == <<reg, corridor, desk, scratch>>

TypeOK ==
  /\ reg \in [seats: 0..Corridor, stamp: 0..MaxStamp]
  /\ corridor \subseteq Flights
  /\ desk \in [Controllers -> {"clear", "reading", "dark"}]
  /\ scratch \in [Controllers -> [seen: 0..Corridor, stamp: 0..MaxStamp,
                                  plane: Flights \cup {NoFlight}]]

Init ==
  /\ reg = [seats |-> 0, stamp |-> 0]
  /\ corridor = {}
  /\ desk = [c \in Controllers |-> "clear"]
  /\ scratch = [c \in Controllers |-> Fresh]

\* The swap is valid only against the stamp the controller actually read.
Swappable(c) ==
  /\ desk[c] = "reading"
  /\ scratch[c].stamp = reg.stamp
  /\ scratch[c].seen < Corridor
  /\ scratch[c].plane \notin corridor
  /\ reg.stamp < MaxStamp

Read(c) ==
  /\ desk[c] = "clear"
  /\ \E f \in Flights :
       scratch' = [scratch EXCEPT ![c] = [seen |-> reg.seats,
                                          stamp |-> reg.stamp, plane |-> f]]
  /\ desk' = [desk EXCEPT ![c] = "reading"]
  /\ UNCHANGED <<reg, corridor>>

\* Admission writes back the count the controller read, plus one.
Admit(c) ==
  /\ Swappable(c)
  /\ reg' = [seats |-> scratch[c].seen + 1, stamp |-> reg.stamp + 1]
  /\ corridor' = corridor \cup {scratch[c].plane}
  /\ desk' = [desk EXCEPT ![c] = "clear"]
  /\ scratch' = [scratch EXCEPT ![c] = Fresh]

Retract(c) ==
  /\ desk[c] = "reading"
  /\ ~Swappable(c)
  /\ desk' = [desk EXCEPT ![c] = "clear"]
  /\ scratch' = [scratch EXCEPT ![c] = Fresh]
  /\ UNCHANGED <<reg, corridor>>

Touchdown ==
  /\ corridor # {}
  /\ reg.seats > 0
  /\ reg.stamp < MaxStamp
  /\ \E f \in corridor : corridor' = corridor \ {f}
  /\ reg' = [seats |-> reg.seats - 1, stamp |-> reg.stamp + 1]
  /\ UNCHANGED <<desk, scratch>>

\* A desk can go dark without warning; its scratchpad is lost with it.
GoDark(c) ==
  /\ desk[c] # "dark"
  /\ desk' = [desk EXCEPT ![c] = "dark"]
  /\ scratch' = [scratch EXCEPT ![c] = Fresh]
  /\ UNCHANGED <<reg, corridor>>

Relieve(c) ==
  /\ desk[c] = "dark"
  /\ desk' = [desk EXCEPT ![c] = "clear"]
  /\ UNCHANGED <<reg, corridor, scratch>>

Next == \E c \in Controllers :
  Read(c) \/ Admit(c) \/ Retract(c) \/ Touchdown \/ GoDark(c) \/ Relieve(c)

Spec == Init /\ [][Next]_vars

\* The approach corridor never holds more aircraft than it is rated for.
CorridorCapacity == Cardinality(corridor) =< Corridor

  /\ UNCHANGED <<occupants, tokenPos, capacity>>

  /\ IF queue = <<>> THEN TRUE ELSE Head(queue) # tokenPos
  /\ tokenPos' = (tokenPos % N) + 1
  /\ UNCHANGED <<occupants, queue, capacity>>

GrantToken ==
  /\ queue # <<>>
  /\ Head(queue) = tokenPos
  /\ Cardinality(occupants) < capacity
  /\ occupants' = occupants \cup {Head(queue)}
  /\ queue' = Tail(queue)
  /\ UNCHANGED <<tokenPos, capacity>>

  /\ t \in occupants
  /\ occupants' = occupants \ {t}
  /\ UNCHANGED <<queue, tokenPos, capacity>>

\* not already been latched out.

  /\ ~latched[b]

---- MODULE W4Od10m4p6t1 ----
EXTENDS Naturals, FiniteSets

CONSTANTS Controllers, MaxEpoch, QueueCap

VARIABLES queue, currentEpoch, authController, authHistory, lastActor, lastEpoch

vars == <<queue, currentEpoch, authController, authHistory, lastActor, lastEpoch>>

\* The bounded queue models a signalling block's inbox of control messages.
\* Backpressure blocks new sends once QueueCap messages are pending.
\* Messages may be picked from the queue in any order (reordering), and a
\* message is applied only if it matches the currently authorized
\* controller and epoch; otherwise it is dropped as unauthorized/stale.

Msgs == [ctrl : Controllers, epoch : 1..MaxEpoch]

TypeOK ==
  /\ queue \subseteq Msgs
  /\ currentEpoch \in 1..MaxEpoch
  /\ authController \in Controllers
  /\ authHistory \subseteq Msgs
  /\ lastActor \in Controllers \cup {"None"}
  /\ lastEpoch \in 0..MaxEpoch

Init ==
  \E a \in Controllers :
    /\ queue = {}
    /\ currentEpoch = 1
    /\ authController = a
    /\ authHistory = {[ctrl |-> a, epoch |-> 1]}
    /\ lastActor = "None"
    /\ lastEpoch = 0

Enqueue(c, e) ==
  /\ Cardinality(queue) < QueueCap
  /\ e <= currentEpoch
  /\ queue' = queue \cup {[ctrl |-> c, epoch |-> e]}
  /\ UNCHANGED <<currentEpoch, authController, authHistory, lastActor, lastEpoch>>

\* Authority handover: the interlocking rotates control of the block to a
\* new controller and bumps the epoch, recording the grant in authHistory.
Rotate ==
  /\ currentEpoch < MaxEpoch
  /\ \E newC \in Controllers \ {authController} :
       /\ currentEpoch' = currentEpoch + 1
       /\ authController' = newC
       /\ authHistory' = authHistory \cup {[ctrl |-> newC, epoch |-> currentEpoch + 1]}
  /\ UNCHANGED <<queue, lastActor, lastEpoch>>

\* A pending message is applied only when it is from the currently
\* authorized controller and stamped with the current epoch.
ApplyValid(m) ==
  /\ m \in queue
  /\ m.ctrl = authController
  /\ m.epoch = currentEpoch
  /\ queue' = queue \ {m}
  /\ lastActor' = m.ctrl
  /\ lastEpoch' = m.epoch
  /\ UNCHANGED <<currentEpoch, authController, authHistory>>

\* An unauthorized or stale message is discarded without effect.
DropStale(m) ==
  /\ m \in queue
  /\ ~(m.ctrl = authController /\ m.epoch = currentEpoch)
  /\ queue' = queue \ {m}
  /\ UNCHANGED <<currentEpoch, authController, authHistory, lastActor, lastEpoch>>

Next ==
  \/ \E c \in Controllers, e \in 1..MaxEpoch : Enqueue(c, e)
  \/ Rotate
  \/ \E m \in queue : ApplyValid(m)
  \/ \E m \in queue : DropStale(m)

Spec == Init /\ [][Next]_vars

\* Safety: any control action that actually took effect must correspond to
\* a genuine authorization grant on record -- this rules out an
\* unauthorized controller or a stale (superseded-epoch) message ever
\* having taken effect on the block.
NoStaleControl ==
  (lastActor # "None") => ([ctrl |-> lastActor, epoch |-> lastEpoch] \in authHistory)

EXTENDS Naturals

\* Each track block is handed out as a timed lease.  A train that is merely
\* slow keeps its block: the interlocking refuses to let the clock retire a
\* lease while the block is still physically occupied.
CONSTANTS Blocks, Trains, Term, Horizon

Outside == "outside"
Unheld == "unheld"

VARIABLES pos, claim, lease, clock
vars == <<pos, claim, lease, clock>>

Until == IF clock + Term < Horizon THEN clock + Term ELSE Horizon

TypeOK ==
  /\ pos \in [Trains -> Blocks \cup {Outside}]
  /\ claim \in [Trains -> Blocks \cup {Outside}]
  /\ lease \in [Blocks -> [holder: Trains \cup {Unheld}, until: 0..Horizon]]
  /\ clock \in 0..Horizon

Init ==
  /\ pos = [t \in Trains |-> Outside]
  /\ claim = [t \in Trains |-> Outside]
  /\ lease = [b \in Blocks |-> [holder |-> Unheld, until |-> 0]]
  /\ clock = 0

Clear(b) == \A t \in Trains : pos[t] # b
Grantable(b) == Clear(b) /\ (lease[b].holder = Unheld \/ lease[b].until < clock)
Valid(t, b) == lease[b].holder = t /\ lease[b].until >= clock
Settled(t) == IF pos[t] = Outside THEN TRUE ELSE lease[pos[t]].until > clock

\* The signalling centre grants a timed lease on an empty, unleased block.
Request(t) ==
  /\ pos[t] = Outside /\ claim[t] = Outside
  /\ \E b \in Blocks :
       /\ Grantable(b)
       /\ lease' = [lease EXCEPT ![b] = [holder |-> t, until |-> Until]]
       /\ claim' = [claim EXCEPT ![t] = b]
  /\ UNCHANGED <<pos, clock>>

Enter(t) ==
  /\ claim[t] # Outside
  /\ Valid(t, claim[t])
  /\ pos' = [pos EXCEPT ![t] = claim[t]]
  /\ claim' = [claim EXCEPT ![t] = Outside]
  /\ UNCHANGED <<lease, clock>>

\* A train that dawdled at the signal loses the grant and gives it back.
Forfeit(t) ==
  /\ claim[t] # Outside
  /\ ~Valid(t, claim[t])
  /\ lease' = [lease EXCEPT ![claim[t]] =
                 IF @.holder = t THEN [holder |-> Unheld, until |-> @.until] ELSE @]
  /\ claim' = [claim EXCEPT ![t] = Outside]
  /\ UNCHANGED <<pos, clock>>

Extend(t) ==
  /\ pos[t] # Outside
  /\ lease' = [lease EXCEPT ![pos[t]].until = Until]
  /\ UNCHANGED <<pos, claim, clock>>

Leave(t) ==
  /\ pos[t] # Outside
  /\ lease' = [lease EXCEPT ![pos[t]] = [holder |-> Unheld, until |-> @.until]]
  /\ pos' = [pos EXCEPT ![t] = Outside]
  /\ UNCHANGED <<claim, clock>>

\* Time only moves on while no occupied block's lease would lapse.
Tick ==
  /\ clock < Horizon
  /\ \A t \in Trains : Settled(t)
  /\ clock' = clock + 1
  /\ UNCHANGED <<pos, claim, lease>>

Next == Tick \/ \E t \in Trains :
  Request(t) \/ Enter(t) \/ Forfeit(t) \/ Extend(t) \/ Leave(t)

Spec == Init /\ [][Next]_vars

\* A train sits inside a block only while that block's lease names it and
\* has not lapsed, so two trains never share a block.
BlockExclusion ==
  \A t \in Trains :
    IF pos[t] = Outside THEN TRUE ELSE Valid(t, pos[t])
====

vars == <<coarse, flock, phase, sealer, inService>>
\* coarse: holder of the line lock ; flock: fine lock holder per block
\* phase: open/sealed per block ; sealer: train that sealed a block
\* inService: blocks currently in service (runtime capacity)

    /\ coarse = NOBODY
    /\ flock = [b \in Blocks |-> NOBODY]
    /\ phase = [b \in Blocks |-> "open"]
    /\ sealer = [b \in Blocks |-> NOBODY]

---------------------------- MODULE W4Od10m8p5t4 ----------------------------
(* A subway signalling block system. Trains take a coarse line lock before     *)
(* any fine block lock (hierarchical locking). Only while holding both locks   *)
(* may a train seal a block -- an irreversible dispatch that can occur at most  *)
(* once per block, since a sealed block is never reopened. Blocks may be taken  *)
(* out of service or restored while idle, so the usable capacity of the line   *)
(* changes at runtime. Locks are released together when a train is done.        *)
EXTENDS Naturals

CONSTANTS Trains, Blocks

VARIABLES coarse, flock, phase, sealer, inService

vars == <<coarse, flock, phase, sealer, inService>>
\* coarse: holder of the line lock ; flock: fine lock holder per block
\* phase: open/sealed per block ; sealer: train that sealed a block
\* inService: blocks currently in service (runtime capacity)

NOBODY == "none"

Init ==
    /\ coarse = NOBODY
    /\ flock = [b \in Blocks |-> NOBODY]
    /\ phase = [b \in Blocks |-> "open"]
    /\ sealer = [b \in Blocks |-> NOBODY]
    /\ inService = Blocks

\* Coarse (line) lock must be taken first.
AcquireCoarse(t) ==
    /\ coarse = NOBODY
    /\ coarse' = t
    /\ UNCHANGED <<flock, phase, sealer, inService>>

\* Fine (block) lock only while already holding the coarse lock; block in service.
AcquireFine(t, b) ==
    /\ coarse = t
    /\ b \in inService
    /\ flock[b] = NOBODY
    /\ flock' = [flock EXCEPT ![b] = t]
    /\ UNCHANGED <<coarse, phase, sealer, inService>>

\* Irreversible dispatch: seals an open block, recording the sealing train.
Dispatch(t, b) ==
    /\ coarse = t
    /\ flock[b] = t
    /\ phase[b] = "open"
    /\ phase' = [phase EXCEPT ![b] = "sealed"]
    /\ sealer' = [sealer EXCEPT ![b] = t]
    /\ UNCHANGED <<coarse, flock, inService>>

\* Releasing the coarse lock also drops every fine lock the train held.
Release(t) ==
    /\ coarse = t
    /\ coarse' = NOBODY
    /\ flock' = [b \in Blocks |-> IF flock[b] = t THEN NOBODY ELSE flock[b]]
    /\ UNCHANGED <<phase, sealer, inService>>

\* Runtime capacity change: an idle block is taken out of or put back in service.
Recapacity(b) ==
    /\ flock[b] = NOBODY
    /\ inService' = IF b \in inService THEN inService \ {b} ELSE inService \cup {b}
    /\ UNCHANGED <<coarse, flock, phase, sealer>>

Next ==
    \/ \E t \in Trains : AcquireCoarse(t)
    \/ \E t \in Trains, b \in Blocks : AcquireFine(t, b)
    \/ \E t \in Trains, b \in Blocks : Dispatch(t, b)
    \/ \E t \in Trains : Release(t)
    \/ \E b \in Blocks : Recapacity(b)

Spec == Init /\ [][Next]_vars

\* Irreversible-at-most-once: a block is marked sealed exactly when a sealing
\* train is on record for it, and no transition ever reopens a sealed block --
\* so the seal happens at most once per block.
SealOnce == \A b \in Blocks : (phase[b] = "sealed") <=> (sealer[b] # NOBODY)

EXTENDS Naturals, FiniteSets

\* Epoch-numbered reconfiguration grants exclusive use of one press to one
\* controller at a time. Grant/Release messages travel over a network
\* modeled as a SET (delivery order is nondeterministic, i.e. reorderable).
\* The invariant protects mutual exclusion: fencing on the message's epoch
\* against the coordinator's live epoch must stop a stale, reordered Grant
\* from ever letting a second controller start using the press.
VARIABLES epoch, assigned, network, holding, procEpoch

Init ==
    /\ epoch = 0
    /\ assigned = NoneP
    /\ network = {}
    /\ holding = {}
    /\ procEpoch = [p \in Processes |-> 0]

Reconfigure ==
    \* Bumping the epoch is a hard fence: the press's own control firmware
    \* only accepts commands stamped with the live epoch, so any process
    \* still believing it holds the press is immediately fenced off here,
    \* even if it has not yet heard about the reconfiguration itself.
    /\ epoch < MaxEpoch
    /\ epoch' = epoch + 1
    /\ assigned' = NoneP
    /\ holding' = {}
    /\ UNCHANGED <<network, procEpoch>>

GrantAccess ==
    /\ assigned = NoneP
    /\ \E p \in Processes :
         /\ assigned' = p
         /\ network' = network \cup {[type |-> "Grant", ep |-> epoch, proc |-> p]}
    /\ UNCHANGED <<epoch, holding, procEpoch>>

DeliverGrant ==
    \E m \in network :
        /\ m.type = "Grant"
        /\ network' = network \ {m}
        /\ procEpoch' = [procEpoch EXCEPT ![m.proc] =
                            IF m.ep > procEpoch[m.proc] THEN m.ep ELSE procEpoch[m.proc]]

        /\ UNCHANGED <<epoch, assigned>>

    \E p \in Processes :
        /\ p \in holding
        /\ holding' = holding \ {p}
        /\ network' = network \cup {[type |-> "Release", ep |-> procEpoch[p], proc |-> p]}
        /\ UNCHANGED <<epoch, assigned, procEpoch>>

    \E m \in network :

        /\ network' = network \ {m}
        /\ assigned' = IF (m.ep = epoch /\ assigned = m.proc) THEN NoneP ELSE assigned
        /\ UNCHANGED <<epoch, holding, procEpoch>>

    \/ GrantAccess
    \/ DeliverGrant
    \/ ReleaseHolding
    \/ DeliverRelease

(* Blood-bank inventory whose cold-storage capacity is resized at runtime by a
   leader-elected coordinator. The leader may expand capacity (adding a free
   slot) or shrink it (removing a free slot), and may deposit or withdraw units.
   Stored units across both bins plus free slots always equal the current
   capacity, even as capacity changes. Leadership is chosen by majority vote
   with failover. *)
EXTENDS Naturals, FiniteSets

CONSTANTS Instances, None
Bins == 1..2
Majority == 2
MaxCap == 3

VARIABLES stored, free, cap, leader, votes

vars == <<stored, free, cap, leader, votes>>

Used == stored[1] + stored[2]

TypeOK ==
    /\ stored \in [Bins -> 0..MaxCap]
    /\ free \in 0..MaxCap
    /\ cap \in 0..MaxCap
    /\ leader \in Instances \cup {None}
    /\ votes \in SUBSET Instances

Init ==
    /\ stored = [b \in Bins |-> 0]
    /\ free = MaxCap
    /\ cap = MaxCap
    /\ leader = None
    /\ votes = {}

StartElection ==
    /\ leader' = None
    /\ votes' = {}
    /\ UNCHANGED <<stored, free, cap>>

Vote(i) ==
    /\ leader = None
    /\ i \notin votes
    /\ votes' = votes \cup {i}
    /\ UNCHANGED <<stored, free, cap, leader>>

Elect(i) ==
    /\ leader = None
    /\ i \in votes
    /\ Cardinality(votes) >= Majority
    /\ leader' = i
    /\ UNCHANGED <<stored, free, cap, votes>>

Deposit(b) ==
    /\ leader # None
    /\ free > 0
    /\ stored' = [stored EXCEPT ![b] = @ + 1]
    /\ free' = free - 1
    /\ UNCHANGED <<cap, leader, votes>>

Withdraw(b) ==
    /\ stored[b] > 0
    /\ stored' = [stored EXCEPT ![b] = @ - 1]
    /\ free' = free + 1
    /\ UNCHANGED <<cap, leader, votes>>

Expand ==
    /\ leader # None
    /\ cap < MaxCap
    /\ cap' = cap + 1
    /\ free' = free + 1
    /\ UNCHANGED <<stored, leader, votes>>

Shrink ==
    /\ leader # None
    /\ free > 0
    /\ cap > 0
    /\ cap' = cap - 1
    /\ free' = free - 1
    /\ UNCHANGED <<stored, leader, votes>>

Next ==
    \/ StartElection
    \/ \E i \in Instances : Vote(i)
    \/ \E i \in Instances : Elect(i)
    \/ \E b \in Bins : Deposit(b)
    \/ \E b \in Bins : Withdraw(b)
    \/ Expand
    \/ Shrink

Spec == Init /\ [][Next]_vars

CapacityCoherent == Used + free = cap
===========================================================================

  /\ held = [m \in Machines |-> 0]

  /\ runState' = [runState EXCEPT ![r] = "asking"]
  /\ batch' = [batch EXCEPT ![r] = n]
  /\ wire' = wire \cup {[tag |-> "ask", mc |-> m, run |-> r] : m \in Machines}

\* decision lands, which is why booked room counts against the shelf too.

  /\ slot[w.mc][w.run] = "clear"
  /\ stock[w.mc] + held[w.mc] + batch[w.run] <= Shelf
  /\ held' = [held EXCEPT ![w.mc] = held[w.mc] + batch[w.run]]
  /\ slot' = [slot EXCEPT ![w.mc][w.run] = "held"]
  /\ wire' = (wire \ {w}) \cup {[tag |-> "yes", mc |-> w.mc, run |-> w.run]}
  /\ UNCHANGED <<stock, runState, batch>>

  /\ w.tag = "ask"
  /\ slot[w.mc][w.run] = "clear"
  /\ stock[w.mc] + held[w.mc] + batch[w.run] > Shelf
  /\ slot' = [slot EXCEPT ![w.mc][w.run] = "refused"]
  /\ wire' = (wire \ {w}) \cup {[tag |-> "no", mc |-> w.mc, run |-> w.run]}
  /\ UNCHANGED <<stock, held, runState, batch>>

  /\ runState[r] = "asking"
  /\ \A m \in Machines : [tag |-> "yes", mc |-> m, run |-> r] \in wire
  /\ runState' = [runState EXCEPT ![r] = "commit"]
  /\ wire' = (wire \ {[tag |-> "yes", mc |-> m, run |-> r] : m \in Machines})
       \cup {[tag |-> "do", mc |-> m, run |-> r] : m \in Machines}
  /\ UNCHANGED <<stock, held, slot, batch>>

DecideAbort(r) ==
  /\ runState[r] = "asking"
  /\ \E m \in Machines : [tag |-> "no", mc |-> m, run |-> r] \in wire
  /\ runState' = [runState EXCEPT ![r] = "abort"]
  /\ wire' = (wire \ {v \in wire : v.run = r /\ v.tag \in {"yes", "no"}})

  /\ UNCHANGED <<stock, held, slot, batch>>

\* room booked for that run, so a replayed decision cannot move stock twice.

  /\ slot[w.mc][w.run] = "held"
  /\ stock' = [stock EXCEPT ![w.mc] = stock[w.mc] + batch[w.run]]
  /\ held' = [held EXCEPT ![w.mc] = held[w.mc] - batch[w.run]]
  /\ slot' = [slot EXCEPT ![w.mc][w.run] = "settled"]
  /\ wire' = wire \ {w}
  /\ UNCHANGED <<runState, batch>>

ApplyUndo(w) ==
  /\ w.tag = "undo"
  /\ slot[w.mc][w.run] = "held"
  /\ held' = [held EXCEPT ![w.mc] = held[w.mc] - batch[w.run]]
  /\ slot' = [slot EXCEPT ![w.mc][w.run] = "settled"]
  /\ wire' = wire \ {w}
  /\ UNCHANGED <<stock, runState, batch>>

  /\ w.tag \in {"do", "undo"}
  /\ slot[w.mc][w.run] # "held"
  /\ wire' = wire \ {w}
  /\ UNCHANGED <<stock, held, slot, runState, batch>>

  \/ \E r \in Runs, n \in 1 .. MaxBatch : OpenRun(r, n)
  \/ \E r \in Runs : DecideCommit(r) \/ DecideAbort(r)

       \/ ApplyUndo(w) \/ DropSpent(w)

Spec == Init /\ [][Next]_vars

\* Cans on the shelf plus room already promised never exceed the shelf.
ShelfNeverOverfilled ==

  /\ quorum' = {}

  /\ UNCHANGED <<round, phase, quorum, installed>>

       /\ quorum' = quorum \cup {m.who}
       /\ pool' = pool \ {m}
  /\ UNCHANGED <<round, phase, installed>>

  /\ quorum # {}

\* can be armed, and the bus is handed straight back once a motor is armed.
\* Turning a motor drops product, which cannot be taken back.

Armed(o) == \E s \in Slots : arm[s] = o

  /\ bus \in Orders \cup {NoOrder}
  /\ arm \in [Slots -> Orders \cup {NoOrder}]
  /\ served \in [Orders -> Slots \cup {NoSlot}]
  /\ credit \in [Orders -> BOOLEAN]
  /\ tech \in BOOLEAN

  /\ arm = [s \in Slots |-> NoOrder]
  /\ served = [o \in Orders |-> NoSlot]
  /\ credit = [o \in Orders |-> FALSE]
  /\ tech = FALSE

Pay(o) ==
  /\ ~credit[o]
  /\ served[o] = NoSlot
  /\ credit' = [credit EXCEPT ![o] = TRUE]
  /\ UNCHANGED <<bus, arm, served, tech>>

TakeBus(o) ==
  /\ bus = NoOrder
  /\ credit[o]
  /\ served[o] = NoSlot
  /\ ~Armed(o)
  /\ bus' = o
  /\ UNCHANGED <<arm, served, credit, tech>>

DropBus(o) ==
  /\ bus = o
  /\ bus' = NoOrder
  /\ UNCHANGED <<arm, served, credit, tech>>

\* Arming is the last point at which the order is checked against the drop
\* record; the bus goes back in the same step.
ArmSlot(o, s) ==

  /\ arm[s] = NoOrder
  /\ served[o] = NoSlot
  /\ arm' = [arm EXCEPT ![s] = o]
  /\ bus' = NoOrder
  /\ UNCHANGED <<served, credit, tech>>

  /\ arm[s] # NoOrder
  /\ served' = [served EXCEPT ![arm[s]] = s]
  /\ credit' = [credit EXCEPT ![arm[s]] = FALSE]
  /\ arm' = [arm EXCEPT ![s] = NoOrder]
  /\ UNCHANGED <<bus, tech>>

  /\ arm[s] # NoOrder
  /\ arm' = [arm EXCEPT ![s] = NoOrder]
  /\ UNCHANGED <<bus, served, credit, tech>>

Callout ==
  /\ ~tech
  /\ tech' = TRUE
  /\ UNCHANGED <<bus, arm, served, credit>>

Signoff ==
  /\ tech
  /\ tech' = FALSE
  /\ UNCHANGED <<bus, arm, served, credit>>

\* touch an order that is already armed somewhere or already served.

---- MODULE W4Od14m3p4t0 ----
(* Wildfire drone swarm with term-based leader election and failover. Only
   the current leader may dispatch a drone into the fire perimeter, and the
   perimeter's simultaneous occupancy is bounded. At most one drone (leader
   or otherwise) can crash silently; failover elects a fresh leader by term,
   and a sweep clears a crashed drone's airspace slot once noticed. *)
EXTENDS Naturals, FiniteSets

CONSTANTS Drones, MaxActive, MaxTerm, NoOne
ASSUME /\ MaxActive \in Nat /\ MaxActive >= 1
       /\ MaxTerm \in Nat /\ MaxTerm >= 2
       /\ Cardinality(Drones) > MaxActive
       /\ NoOne \notin Drones

VARIABLES leader, term, crashed, active

vars == <<leader, term, crashed, active>>

TypeOK == /\ leader \in Drones \cup {NoOne}
          /\ term \in 0..MaxTerm
          /\ crashed \subseteq Drones /\ Cardinality(crashed) <= 1
          /\ active \subseteq Drones

Init == /\ leader = NoOne
        /\ term = 0
        /\ crashed = {}
        /\ active = {}

\* Election happens when there is no leader, or the leader has crashed.
Elect == /\ term < MaxTerm
         /\ leader = NoOne \/ leader \in crashed
         /\ \E d \in Drones \ crashed :
               /\ leader' = d
               /\ term' = term + 1
         /\ UNCHANGED <<crashed, active>>

\* Only a live, current leader may dispatch a drone, under the capacity bound.
Dispatch == /\ leader # NoOne /\ leader \notin crashed
            /\ \E d \in Drones \ active :
                  /\ Cardinality(active) < MaxActive
                  /\ active' = active \cup {d}
            /\ UNCHANGED <<leader, term, crashed>>

Recall == \E d \in active : active' = active \ {d} /\ UNCHANGED <<leader, term, crashed>>

\* At most one drone crashes silently, at any time.
Crash == /\ crashed = {}
         /\ \E d \in Drones : crashed' = {d}
         /\ UNCHANGED <<leader, term, active>>

\* Failover sweep: a noticed crashed drone is dropped from the active roster.
ClearCrashed == \E d \in crashed \cap active : active' = active \ {d} /\ UNCHANGED <<leader, term, crashed>>

Next == Elect \/ Dispatch \/ Recall \/ Crash \/ ClearCrashed

Spec == Init /\ [][Next]_vars

\* Literal property: airspace occupancy never exceeds the configured bound.
CapacityBound == Cardinality(active) <= MaxActive

EXTENDS Naturals, FiniteSets

CONSTANTS Members, RingSize, Slots, Orders, MaxToken, MaxOverrides, NoOrder

\* The token goes to the next seat or the one past it, so a quiet member does not
\* hold the whole auction up.
Onward(m, k) == ((m + k - 1) % RingSize) + 1

VARIABLES occupant, freeList, token, seat, overrides

vars == <<occupant, freeList, token, seat, overrides>>

TypeOK ==
    /\ occupant \in [Slots -> {NoOrder} \cup Orders]
    /\ freeList \in SUBSET Slots
    /\ token \in 1..MaxToken
    /\ seat \in [Members -> 0..MaxToken]
    /\ overrides \in 0..MaxOverrides

Init ==
    /\ occupant = [s \in Slots |-> NoOrder]
    /\ freeList = Slots
    /\ token = 1
    /\ seat = [m \in Members |-> IF m = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0]
    /\ overrides = 0

Unplaced(o) == \A s \in Slots : occupant[s] # o

\* Both views move together: off the free list and onto the slot record.
Award(s, o) ==
    /\ s \in freeList
    /\ Unplaced(o)
    /\ occupant' = [occupant EXCEPT ![s] = o]
    /\ freeList' = freeList \ {s}

Fill(m, s, o) ==
    /\ seat[m] = token
    /\ Award(s, o)
    /\ UNCHANGED <<token, seat, overrides>>

Override(s, o) ==
    /\ overrides < MaxOverrides
    /\ Award(s, o)
    /\ overrides' = overrides + 1
    /\ UNCHANGED <<token, seat>>

Release(s) ==
    /\ occupant[s] # NoOrder
    /\ occupant' = [occupant EXCEPT ![s] = NoOrder]
    /\ freeList' = freeList \cup {s}
    /\ UNCHANGED <<token, seat, overrides>>

Pass(m, k) ==
    /\ seat[m] = token
    /\ token < MaxToken
    /\ token' = token + 1
    /\ seat' = [seat EXCEPT ![m] = 0, ![Onward(m, k)] = token + 1]
    /\ UNCHANGED <<occupant, freeList, overrides>>

ReForm(m) ==
    /\ token = MaxToken
    /\ token' = 1
    /\ seat' = [x \in Members |-> IF x = m THEN 1 ELSE 0]
    /\ UNCHANGED <<occupant, freeList, overrides>>

    \/ \E m \in Members, s \in Slots, o \in Orders : Fill(m, s, o)

    \/ \E s \in Slots : Release(s)

    \/ \E m \in Members : ReForm(m)

---- MODULE W4Od16m0p5t0 ----
EXTENDS Naturals, FiniteSets, Sequences

(* A pharmacy prescription dispenser fills scripts under optimistic locking with  *)
(* retry.  Filling a script is irreversible and must happen at most once.  A       *)
(* dispenser snapshots a global version, and its fill commits only if the          *)
(* snapshot is still current, which bumps the version so a stale attempt must      *)
(* abort and retry.  One dispenser may crash silently.  Every fill is appended to  *)
(* an audit log that must never name the same script twice.                        *)

CONSTANT MaxV

Scripts    == {"rx1", "rx2"}
Dispensers == {"d1", "d2"}
NoSnap     == MaxV + 1

VARIABLES gver, dispensed, auditLog, snap, crashed

vars == << gver, dispensed, auditLog, snap, crashed >>

TypeOK ==
    /\ gver \in 0..MaxV
    /\ dispensed \subseteq Scripts
    /\ auditLog \in Seq(Scripts)
    /\ snap \in [Dispensers -> 0..(MaxV + 1)]
    /\ crashed \subseteq Dispensers

Init ==
    /\ gver = 0
    /\ dispensed = {}
    /\ auditLog = << >>
    /\ snap = [d \in Dispensers |-> NoSnap]
    /\ crashed = {}

\* Snapshot the current global version (no outstanding attempt).
Prepare(d) ==
    /\ d \notin crashed
    /\ snap[d] = NoSnap
    /\ snap' = [snap EXCEPT ![d] = gver]
    /\ UNCHANGED << gver, dispensed, auditLog, crashed >>

Bump ==
    /\ gver < MaxV
    /\ gver' = gver + 1
    /\ UNCHANGED << dispensed, auditLog, snap, crashed >>

\* Commit the irreversible fill only if the optimistic snapshot still holds.
Commit(d, s) ==
    /\ d \notin crashed
    /\ snap[d] # NoSnap
    /\ snap[d] = gver
    /\ s \notin dispensed
    /\ dispensed' = dispensed \cup {s}
    /\ auditLog' = Append(auditLog, s)
    /\ gver' = IF gver < MaxV THEN gver + 1 ELSE gver
    /\ snap' = [snap EXCEPT ![d] = NoSnap]
    /\ UNCHANGED crashed

Abort(d) ==
    /\ snap[d] # NoSnap
    /\ snap' = [snap EXCEPT ![d] = NoSnap]
    /\ UNCHANGED << gver, dispensed, auditLog, crashed >>

Crash(d) ==
    /\ d \notin crashed
    /\ Cardinality(crashed) < 1
    /\ crashed' = crashed \cup {d}
    /\ snap' = [snap EXCEPT ![d] = NoSnap]
    /\ UNCHANGED << gver, dispensed, auditLog >>

Reset ==
    /\ \A s \in Scripts : s \in dispensed
    /\ gver' = 0
    /\ dispensed' = {}
    /\ auditLog' = << >>
    /\ snap' = [d \in Dispensers |-> NoSnap]
    /\ crashed' = {}

Next ==
    \/ \E d \in Dispensers : Prepare(d)
    \/ Bump
    \/ \E d \in Dispensers, s \in Scripts : Commit(d, s)
    \/ \E d \in Dispensers : Abort(d)
    \/ \E d \in Dispensers : Crash(d)
    \/ Reset

Spec == Init /\ [][Next]_vars

(* The irreversible fill happens at most once per script: no script is ever      *)
(* named twice in the audit log.                                                 *)
FillAtMostOnce ==
    \A a, b \in 1..Len(auditLog) : (auditLog[a] = auditLog[b]) => (a = b)

\* A request carries the term its author believed was in force; a takeover since
\* then is exactly what makes the stamp worthless.

    /\ log \in Seq(Stations)
    /\ Len(log) <= MaxLog
    /\ told \in [Stations -> 0..MaxLog]
    /\ leader \in Stations
    /\ term \in 1..MaxTerm
    /\ outstanding \in SUBSET Requests

    /\ log = << >>
    /\ told = [s \in Stations |-> 0]
    /\ leader \in Stations
    /\ term = 1
    /\ outstanding = {}

Submit(r) ==
    /\ r \notin outstanding
    /\ r.stamp = term
    /\ outstanding' = outstanding \cup {r}
    /\ UNCHANGED <<log, told, leader, term>>

\* The log only ever grows at the end, and the author is told where its entry sits.
Write(r) ==
    /\ r \in outstanding
    /\ r.stamp = term
    /\ Len(log) < MaxLog
    /\ log' = Append(log, r.who)
    /\ told' = [told EXCEPT ![r.who] = Len(log) + 1]
    /\ outstanding' = outstanding \ {r}
    /\ UNCHANGED <<leader, term>>

Refuse(r) ==
    /\ r \in outstanding
    /\ r.stamp # term
    /\ outstanding' = outstanding \ {r}
    /\ UNCHANGED <<log, told, leader, term>>

    /\ r \in outstanding
    /\ r.stamp = term
    /\ Len(log) = MaxLog
    /\ outstanding' = outstanding \ {r}
    /\ UNCHANGED <<log, told, leader, term>>

    /\ s # leader
    /\ term < MaxTerm
    /\ leader' = s
    /\ term' = term + 1
    /\ UNCHANGED <<log, told, outstanding>>

    \A s \in Stations :

EveryRequestResolves ==
    \A r \in Requests : (r \in outstanding) ~> (r \notin outstanding)

\* capacity may change at runtime. Prescriptions then move to processing and finally to dispensed.
\* No prescription is created or destroyed: the four stages always sum to the fixed total.

    \/ Recycle

EXTENDS Naturals, FiniteSets

CONSTANTS Instances, Reqs, Reviewers, Quorum, Cap

VARIABLES pending, votes, active, done
vars == <<pending, votes, active, done>>

Voters(r) == { x.rev : x \in { y \in votes : y.req = r } }

TypeOK ==
    /\ pending \subseteq [id : Reqs, inst : Instances]
    /\ votes \subseteq [req : Reqs, rev : Reviewers]
    /\ active \subseteq Reqs
    /\ done \subseteq Reqs

Init ==
    /\ pending = {}
    /\ votes = {}
    /\ active = {}
    /\ done = {}

Submit(i, r) ==
    /\ r \notin active
    /\ r \notin done
    /\ \A p \in pending : p.id # r
    /\ pending' = pending \cup {[id |-> r, inst |-> i]}
    /\ UNCHANGED <<votes, active, done>>

Vote(v, r) ==
    /\ \E p \in pending : p.id = r
    /\ [req |-> r, rev |-> v] \notin votes
    /\ votes' = votes \cup {[req |-> r, rev |-> v]}
    /\ UNCHANGED <<pending, active, done>>

Begin(r) ==
    /\ \E p \in pending : p.id = r
    /\ Cardinality(Voters(r)) >= Quorum
    /\ Cardinality(active) < Cap
    /\ active' = active \cup {r}
    /\ pending' = { p \in pending : p.id # r }
    /\ UNCHANGED <<votes, done>>

Complete(r) ==
    /\ r \in active
    /\ active' = active \ {r}
    /\ done' = done \cup {r}
    /\ UNCHANGED <<pending, votes>>

Recall(r) ==
    /\ r \in done
    /\ done' = done \ {r}
    /\ votes' = { x \in votes : x.req # r }
    /\ UNCHANGED <<pending, active>>

Next ==
    \/ \E i \in Instances, r \in Reqs : Submit(i, r)
    \/ \E v \in Reviewers, r \in Reqs : Vote(v, r)
    \/ \E r \in Reqs : Begin(r)
    \/ \E r \in Reqs : Complete(r)
    \/ \E r \in Reqs : Recall(r)

Spec == Init /\ [][Next]_vars

CapOK ==
    /\ Cardinality(active) <= Cap
    /\ \A r \in active : Cardinality(Voters(r)) >= Quorum
============================================================================

EXTENDS Naturals, Sequences

CONSTANTS N, TOTAL, CAP

ASSUME N \in Nat /\ N > 1 /\ TOTAL \in Nat /\ CAP \in Nat

Station == 0..(N - 1)
Move == {m \in Station \X Station : m[1] # m[2]}
SrcOf(m) == m[1]
DstOf(m) == m[2]

RECURSIVE SumF(_, _)
SumF(f, S) ==
    IF S = {} THEN 0
    ELSE LET x == CHOOSE y \in S : TRUE IN f[x] + SumF(f, S \ {x})

VARIABLES station, queue, transit, admin
vars == <<station, queue, transit, admin>>

TypeOK ==
    /\ station \in [Station -> 0..TOTAL]
    /\ queue \in Seq(Move)
    /\ transit \in [Move -> 0..TOTAL]
    /\ admin \in BOOLEAN

Init ==
    /\ station = [s \in Station |-> IF s = 0 THEN TOTAL ELSE 0]
    /\ queue = <<>>
    /\ transit = [m \in Move |-> 0]
    /\ admin = FALSE

Enqueue(m) ==
    /\ Len(queue) < CAP
    /\ queue' = Append(queue, m)
    /\ UNCHANGED <<station, transit, admin>>

Pick ==
    /\ Len(queue) > 0
    /\ station[SrcOf(Head(queue))] >= 1
    /\ station' = [station EXCEPT ![SrcOf(Head(queue))] = station[SrcOf(Head(queue))] - 1]
    /\ transit' = [transit EXCEPT ![Head(queue)] = transit[Head(queue)] + 1]
    /\ queue' = Tail(queue)
    /\ UNCHANGED admin

Deliver(m) ==
    /\ transit[m] > 0
    /\ station' = [station EXCEPT ![DstOf(m)] = station[DstOf(m)] + 1]
    /\ transit' = [transit EXCEPT ![m] = transit[m] - 1]
    /\ UNCHANGED <<queue, admin>>

AdminMove(src, dst) ==
    /\ admin
    /\ src # dst
    /\ station[src] >= 1
    /\ station' = [station EXCEPT ![src] = station[src] - 1, ![dst] = station[dst] + 1]
    /\ UNCHANGED <<queue, transit, admin>>

    /\ queue' = Tail(queue)

    \/ \E src \in Station, dst \in Station : AdminMove(src, dst)

    \/ ToggleAdmin

EXTENDS Integers, FiniteSets

\* Airport baggage router: each conveyor zone holds one shared manifest tally.
\* Updating it is a coarse-then-fine locking dance: a worker takes the zone
\* lock, then the record lock, snapshots the tally into a local cache, and
\* only later writes the incremented value back. Holding both locks for the
\* whole read-modify-write window is what stops a second worker's write from
\* silently clobbering (losing) the first worker's update. Exactly one
\* worker may crash mid-transaction, silently, leaving its locks stranded
\* until an operator force-releases them.
CONSTANTS Worker, Zone, MaxVal

NoW == "NoW"
NoCache == -1

VARIABLES coarseLock, fineLock, val, cache, crashed

vars == <<coarseLock, fineLock, val, cache, crashed>>

TypeOK ==
  /\ coarseLock \in [Zone -> Worker \cup {NoW}]
  /\ fineLock \in [Zone -> Worker \cup {NoW}]
  /\ val \in [Zone -> 0..MaxVal]
  /\ cache \in [Worker -> (0..MaxVal) \cup {NoCache}]
  /\ crashed \subseteq Worker

Init ==
  /\ coarseLock = [z \in Zone |-> NoW]
  /\ fineLock = [z \in Zone |-> NoW]
  /\ val = [z \in Zone |-> 0]
  /\ cache = [w \in Worker |-> NoCache]
  /\ crashed = {}

AcquireCoarse(w, z) ==
  /\ w \notin crashed
  /\ coarseLock[z] = NoW
  /\ coarseLock' = [coarseLock EXCEPT ![z] = w]
  \/ UNCHANGED <<fineLock, val, cache, crashed>>

AcquireFine(w, z) ==
  /\ w \notin crashed
  /\ coarseLock[z] = w
  /\ fineLock[z] = NoW
  /\ fineLock' = [fineLock EXCEPT ![z] = w]
  /\ UNCHANGED <<coarseLock, val, cache, crashed>>

ReadSnapshot(w, z) ==
  /\ w \notin crashed
  /\ fineLock[z] = w
  /\ cache[w] = NoCache
  /\ cache' = [cache EXCEPT ![w] = val[z]]
  /\ UNCHANGED <<coarseLock, fineLock, val, crashed>>

\* Writes back the incremented tally and releases both locks in one step,
\* completing the read-modify-write started by ReadSnapshot.
WriteBack(w, z) ==
  /\ w \notin crashed
  /\ fineLock[z] = w
  /\ cache[w] # NoCache
  /\ val' = [val EXCEPT ![z] = (cache[w] + 1) % (MaxVal + 1)]
  /\ cache' = [cache EXCEPT ![w] = NoCache]
  /\ fineLock' = [fineLock EXCEPT ![z] = NoW]
  /\ coarseLock' = [coarseLock EXCEPT ![z] = NoW]
  /\ UNCHANGED crashed

\* Exactly one worker, ever, may crash silently while mid-transaction.
Crash(w) ==
  /\ w \notin crashed
  /\ Cardinality(crashed) = 0
  /\ crashed' = crashed \cup {w}

ForceRelease(z) ==

  /\ UNCHANGED <<val, crashed>>

---- MODULE W4Od17m8p1t0 ----
EXTENDS Integers, FiniteSets

\* Airport baggage router: each conveyor zone holds one shared manifest tally.
\* Updating it is a coarse-then-fine locking dance: a worker takes the zone
\* lock, then the record lock, snapshots the tally into a local cache, and
\* only later writes the incremented value back. Holding both locks for the
\* whole read-modify-write window is what stops a second worker's write from
\* silently clobbering (losing) the first worker's update. Exactly one
\* worker may crash mid-transaction, silently, leaving its locks stranded
\* until an operator force-releases them.
CONSTANTS Worker, Zone, MaxVal

NoW == "NoW"
NoCache == -1

VARIABLES coarseLock, fineLock, val, cache, crashed

vars == <<coarseLock, fineLock, val, cache, crashed>>

TypeOK ==
  /\ coarseLock \in [Zone -> Worker \cup {NoW}]
  /\ fineLock \in [Zone -> Worker \cup {NoW}]
  /\ val \in [Zone -> 0..MaxVal]
  /\ cache \in [Worker -> (0..MaxVal) \cup {NoCache}]
  /\ crashed \subseteq Worker

Init ==
  /\ coarseLock = [z \in Zone |-> NoW]
  /\ fineLock = [z \in Zone |-> NoW]
  /\ val = [z \in Zone |-> 0]
  /\ cache = [w \in Worker |-> NoCache]
  /\ crashed = {}

AcquireCoarse(w, z) ==
  /\ w \notin crashed
  /\ coarseLock[z] = NoW
  /\ coarseLock' = [coarseLock EXCEPT ![z] = w]
  /\ UNCHANGED <<fineLock, val, cache, crashed>>

AcquireFine(w, z) ==
  /\ w \notin crashed
  /\ coarseLock[z] = w
  /\ fineLock[z] = NoW
  /\ fineLock' = [fineLock EXCEPT ![z] = w]
  /\ UNCHANGED <<coarseLock, val, cache, crashed>>

ReadSnapshot(w, z) ==
  /\ w \notin crashed
  /\ fineLock[z] = w
  /\ cache[w] = NoCache
  /\ cache' = [cache EXCEPT ![w] = val[z]]
  /\ UNCHANGED <<coarseLock, fineLock, val, crashed>>

\* Writes back the incremented tally and releases both locks in one step,
\* completing the read-modify-write started by ReadSnapshot.
WriteBack(w, z) ==
  /\ w \notin crashed
  /\ fineLock[z] = w
  /\ cache[w] # NoCache
  /\ val' = [val EXCEPT ![z] = (cache[w] + 1) % (MaxVal + 1)]
  /\ cache' = [cache EXCEPT ![w] = NoCache]
  /\ fineLock' = [fineLock EXCEPT ![z] = NoW]
  /\ coarseLock' = [coarseLock EXCEPT ![z] = NoW]
  /\ UNCHANGED crashed

\* Exactly one worker, ever, may crash silently while mid-transaction.
Crash(w) ==
  /\ w \notin crashed
  /\ Cardinality(crashed) = 0
  /\ crashed' = crashed \cup {w}
  /\ UNCHANGED <<coarseLock, fineLock, val, cache>>

\* Operator recovery: reclaim a crashed worker's stranded locks and discard
\* its abandoned in-flight snapshot for that zone.
ForceRelease(z) ==
  /\ coarseLock[z] # NoW
  /\ coarseLock[z] \in crashed
  /\ LET w == coarseLock[z] IN
       /\ coarseLock' = [coarseLock EXCEPT ![z] = NoW]
       /\ fineLock' = IF fineLock[z] = w THEN [fineLock EXCEPT ![z] = NoW] ELSE fineLock
       /\ cache' = [cache EXCEPT ![w] = NoCache]
  /\ UNCHANGED <<val, crashed>>

Next ==
  \/ \E w \in Worker, z \in Zone :
       AcquireCoarse(w, z) \/ AcquireFine(w, z) \/ ReadSnapshot(w, z) \/ WriteBack(w, z)
  \/ \E w \in Worker : Crash(w)
  \/ \E z \in Zone : ForceRelease(z)

Spec == Init /\ [][Next]_vars

\* SAFETY: the fine (record) lock never outruns the coarse (zone) lock, and
\* any worker with an in-flight cached read still holds the matching fine
\* lock -- together these guarantee the read-modify-write window on a
\* zone's tally is never split open for a second writer to lose an update.
NoLostUpdate ==
  /\ \A z \in Zone : fineLock[z] # NoW => coarseLock[z] = fineLock[z]
  /\ \A w \in Worker : cache[w] # NoCache => \E z \in Zone : fineLock[z] = w

---- MODULE W4Od18m4p6t0 ----
\* A smart-home door-lock network processes lock and unlock commands through a bounded queue with
\* backpressure. Only a currently enrolled device may enqueue or run a command, and one device may
\* crash silently, after which it issues nothing more. Running a command latches the door and records
\* which device actuated it. Revoking a device drops it from the enrolled set and immediately clears
\* any door it had latched, and a command from a no-longer-enrolled device is discarded rather than
\* run. Thus every door that is latched was actuated by a device that is still enrolled -- no stale
\* or unauthorized participant leaves a standing effect.
EXTENDS Naturals, Sequences

NONE == "none"
Devices == {"d1", "d2"}
Doors == {"g1"}
QCap == 2
Cmds == {"lock", "unlock"}

VARIABLES enrolled, crashed, queue, actor, latch

Msg == [dev: Devices, door: Doors, cmd: Cmds]

TypeOK ==
  /\ enrolled \in SUBSET Devices
  /\ crashed \in SUBSET Devices
  /\ queue \in Seq(Msg)
  /\ actor \in [Doors -> Devices \cup {NONE}]
  /\ latch \in [Doors -> Cmds \cup {NONE}]

Init ==
  /\ enrolled = Devices
  /\ crashed = {}
  /\ queue = << >>
  /\ actor = [g \in Doors |-> NONE]
  /\ latch = [g \in Doors |-> NONE]

Enqueue(d, g, k) ==
  /\ Len(queue) < QCap
  /\ d \in enrolled
  /\ d \notin crashed
  /\ queue' = Append(queue, [dev |-> d, door |-> g, cmd |-> k])
  /\ UNCHANGED <<enrolled, crashed, actor, latch>>

Run ==
  /\ queue # << >>
  /\ LET m == Head(queue) IN
       /\ m.dev \in enrolled
       /\ m.dev \notin crashed
       /\ actor' = [actor EXCEPT ![m.door] = m.dev]
       /\ latch' = [latch EXCEPT ![m.door] = m.cmd]
       /\ queue' = Tail(queue)
       /\ UNCHANGED <<enrolled, crashed>>

Discard ==
  /\ queue # << >>
  /\ Head(queue).dev \notin enrolled
  /\ queue' = Tail(queue)
  /\ UNCHANGED <<enrolled, crashed, actor, latch>>

Revoke(d) ==
  /\ d \in enrolled
  /\ enrolled' = enrolled \ {d}
  /\ actor' = [g \in Doors |-> IF actor[g] = d THEN NONE ELSE actor[g]]
  /\ latch' = [g \in Doors |-> IF actor[g] = d THEN NONE ELSE latch[g]]
  /\ UNCHANGED <<crashed, queue>>

Enroll(d) ==
  /\ d \notin enrolled
  /\ d \notin crashed
  /\ enrolled' = enrolled \cup {d}
  /\ UNCHANGED <<crashed, queue, actor, latch>>

Crash(d) ==
  /\ d \notin crashed
  /\ crashed' = crashed \cup {d}
  /\ UNCHANGED <<enrolled, queue, actor, latch>>

Recover(d) ==
  /\ d \in crashed
  /\ crashed' = crashed \ {d}
  /\ UNCHANGED <<enrolled, queue, actor, latch>>

Next ==
  \/ \E d \in Devices, g \in Doors, k \in Cmds : Enqueue(d, g, k)
  \/ Run
  \/ Discard
  \/ \E d \in Devices : Revoke(d)
  \/ \E d \in Devices : Enroll(d)
  \/ \E d \in Devices : Crash(d)
  \/ \E d \in Devices : Recover(d)

Spec == Init /\ [][Next]_<<enrolled, crashed, queue, actor, latch>>

LatchedByEnrolled ==
  \A g \in Doors : actor[g] # NONE => actor[g] \in enrolled

------------------------- MODULE W4Od18m6p6t4 -------------------------
EXTENDS Naturals, FiniteSets

CONSTANTS Locks, Users, MaxCap, MaxGen

VARIABLES
    cap,        \* current runtime capacity: max number of active leases
    holder,     \* [Locks -> Users \cup {"none"}] : current lease holder
    gen,        \* [Locks -> Nat] : lease generation, bumped each acquisition
    acting,     \* [Locks -> Users \cup {"none"}] : user mid-unlock
    actGen      \* [Locks -> Nat] : generation the in-progress unlock started under

vars == << cap, holder, gen, acting, actGen >>

NumActive == Cardinality({l \in Locks : holder[l] # "none"})

TypeOK ==
    /\ cap \in 1..MaxCap
    /\ holder \in [Locks -> Users \cup {"none"}]
    /\ gen \in [Locks -> 0..MaxGen]
    /\ acting \in [Locks -> Users \cup {"none"}]
    /\ actGen \in [Locks -> 0..MaxGen]

Init ==
    /\ cap = 1
    /\ holder = [l \in Locks |-> "none"]
    /\ gen = [l \in Locks |-> 0]
    /\ acting = [l \in Locks |-> "none"]
    /\ actGen = [l \in Locks |-> 0]

\* A user leases an unleased lock if capacity allows; the generation bumps.
Acquire(l, u) ==
    /\ holder[l] = "none"
    /\ NumActive < cap
    /\ gen[l] < MaxGen
    /\ holder' = [holder EXCEPT ![l] = u]
    /\ gen' = [gen EXCEPT ![l] = gen[l] + 1]
    /\ UNCHANGED << cap, acting, actGen >>

\* Only the current holder may start an unlock; it is stamped with the generation.
Unlock(l, u) ==
    /\ holder[l] = u
    /\ acting[l] = "none"
    /\ acting' = [acting EXCEPT ![l] = u]
    /\ actGen' = [actGen EXCEPT ![l] = gen[l]]
    /\ UNCHANGED << cap, holder, gen >>

\* An unlock completes.
Finish(l) ==
    /\ acting[l] # "none"
    /\ acting' = [acting EXCEPT ![l] = "none"]
    /\ UNCHANGED << cap, holder, gen, actGen >>

\* The holder voluntarily releases the lease when no unlock is in progress.
Release(l) ==
    /\ holder[l] # "none"
    /\ acting[l] = "none"
    /\ holder' = [holder EXCEPT ![l] = "none"]
    /\ UNCHANGED << cap, gen, acting, actGen >>

\* The hub revokes a lock's lease, aborting any unlock in progress.
Revoke(l) ==
    /\ holder[l] # "none"
    /\ holder' = [holder EXCEPT ![l] = "none"]
    /\ acting' = [acting EXCEPT ![l] = "none"]
    /\ UNCHANGED << cap, gen, actGen >>

\* Runtime capacity changes.
RaiseCap ==
    /\ cap < MaxCap
    /\ cap' = cap + 1
    /\ UNCHANGED << holder, gen, acting, actGen >>

LowerCap ==
    /\ cap > 1
    /\ cap' = cap - 1
    /\ UNCHANGED << holder, gen, acting, actGen >>

Next ==
    \/ \E l \in Locks, u \in Users : Acquire(l, u)
    \/ \E l \in Locks, u \in Users : Unlock(l, u)
    \/ \E l \in Locks : Finish(l)
    \/ \E l \in Locks : Release(l)
    \/ \E l \in Locks : Revoke(l)
    \/ RaiseCap
    \/ LowerCap

Spec == Init /\ [][Next]_vars

\* No unauthorized or stale operation: an unlock in progress is driven by the
\* lock's current holder under its current lease generation.
OnlyHolderActs ==
    \A l \in Locks :
        acting[l] # "none" =>
            (acting[l] = holder[l] /\ actGen[l] = gen[l])

InFlight == LET g[S \in SUBSET Slots] ==
                IF S = {} THEN 0

---- MODULE W4Od18m7p2t1 ----
EXTENDS Naturals

CONSTANTS Locks, SlotCount, Budget, MaxTune, EMPTY

Slots == 1..SlotCount

\* reserve: credits still at the hub; allowance: credits at each lock.
\* counter: the lock's compare-and-swap value; slot: grant slots, delivered
\* to the locks in whatever order the mesh happens to manage.
VARIABLES reserve, allowance, counter, slot

vars == <<reserve, allowance, counter, slot>>

Grants == [to: Locks, amt: 1..Budget, seen: 0..MaxTune]

TypeOK ==
    /\ reserve \in 0..Budget
    /\ allowance \in [Locks -> 0..Budget]
    /\ counter \in [Locks -> 0..MaxTune]
    /\ slot \in [Slots -> Grants \cup {EMPTY}]

Init ==
    /\ reserve = Budget
    /\ allowance = [l \in Locks |-> 0]
    /\ counter = [l \in Locks |-> 0]
    /\ slot = [i \in Slots |-> EMPTY]

Held == LET f[S \in SUBSET Locks] ==
            IF S = {} THEN 0
            ELSE LET l == CHOOSE x \in S : TRUE IN allowance[l] + f[S \ {l}]
        IN f[Locks]

InFlight == LET g[S \in SUBSET Slots] ==
                IF S = {} THEN 0
                ELSE LET i == CHOOSE x \in S : TRUE
                     IN (IF slot[i] = EMPTY THEN 0 ELSE slot[i].amt) + g[S \ {i}]
            IN g[Slots]

\* The reserve is debited the instant the grant is handed to the radio.
Issue(l, n, i) ==
    /\ slot[i] = EMPTY
    /\ n <= reserve
    /\ reserve' = reserve - n
    /\ slot' = [slot EXCEPT ![i] = [to |-> l, amt |-> n, seen |-> counter[l]]]
    /\ UNCHANGED <<allowance, counter>>

Apply(i) ==
    /\ slot[i] # EMPTY
    /\ counter[slot[i].to] = slot[i].seen
    /\ allowance' = [allowance EXCEPT ![slot[i].to] = @ + slot[i].amt]
    /\ counter' = [counter EXCEPT ![slot[i].to] = @ + 1]
    /\ slot' = [slot EXCEPT ![i] = EMPTY]
    /\ UNCHANGED reserve

\* A grant the lock will not honour goes back whole, never partly.
Bounce(i) ==
    /\ slot[i] # EMPTY
    /\ counter[slot[i].to] # slot[i].seen
    /\ reserve' = reserve + slot[i].amt
    /\ slot' = [slot EXCEPT ![i] = EMPTY]
    /\ UNCHANGED <<allowance, counter>>

Return(l, n) ==
    /\ n <= allowance[l]
    /\ allowance' = [allowance EXCEPT ![l] = @ - n]
    /\ reserve' = reserve + n
    /\ UNCHANGED <<counter, slot>>

Retune(l) ==
    /\ counter[l] < MaxTune
    /\ counter' = [counter EXCEPT ![l] = @ + 1]
    /\ UNCHANGED <<reserve, allowance, slot>>

Next ==
    \/ \E l \in Locks, n \in 1..Budget, i \in Slots : Issue(l, n, i)
    \/ \E i \in Slots : Apply(i) \/ Bounce(i)
    \/ \E l \in Locks, n \in 1..Budget : Return(l, n)
    \/ \E l \in Locks : Retune(l)

Spec == Init /\ [][Next]_vars

CreditsAreConserved == reserve + Held + InFlight = Budget

\* Counters advance on every applied grant, so the run is cut off once every
\* lock has been re-stamped MaxTune times.
CounterBound == \A l \in Locks : counter[l] <= MaxTune

\* reclaiming credentials. The invariant protects the conservation law:
\* available + held always equals the current capacity, since claims and
\* releases only move credentials and only capacity changes mint/reclaim
\* them.

    /\ available \in 0..MaxCapacity
    /\ heldBy \subseteq Locks
    /\ waiting \subseteq Locks

    /\ capacity = InitCapacity
    /\ available = InitCapacity
    /\ heldBy = {}
    /\ waiting = {}

\* A lock with no pending request and no held credential asks for one.

    /\ l \notin waiting
    /\ l \notin heldBy
    /\ waiting' = waiting \cup {l}
    /\ UNCHANGED <<capacity, available, heldBy>>

\* A waiting lock atomically claims a credential via compare-and-swap,
\* provided the pool is currently non-empty.
ClaimCredential(l) ==
    /\ l \in waiting
    /\ available > 0
    /\ available' = available - 1
    /\ heldBy' = heldBy \cup {l}
    /\ waiting' = waiting \ {l}
    /\ UNCHANGED capacity

\* A holding lock returns its credential to the pool.
ReleaseCredential(l) =
    /\ l \in heldBy
    /\ heldBy' = heldBy \ {l}
    /\ available' = available + 1
    /\ UNCHANGED <<capacity, waiting>>

\* The homeowner raises capacity, minting new credentials into the pool.

    /\ \E k \in 1..MaxDelta :
        /\ capacity + k <= MaxCapacity
        /\ capacity' = capacity + k
        /\ available' = available + k
    /\ UNCHANGED <<heldBy, waiting>>

\* The homeowner lowers capacity, reclaiming unclaimed credentials --
\* only when no lock has a pending request, so no request is starved.
DecreaseCapacity ==
    /\ waiting = {}
    /\ \E k \in 1..available :
        /\ capacity' = capacity - k
        /\ available' = available - k
    /\ UNCHANGED <<heldBy, waiting>>

Next ==
    \/ \E l \in Locks : RequestCredential(l)
    \/ \E l \in Locks : ClaimCredential(l)
    \/ \E l \in Locks : ReleaseCredential(l)
    \/ IncreaseCapacity
    \/ DecreaseCapacity

    /\ Init
    /\ [][Next]_vars
    /\ \A l \in Locks : SF_vars(ClaimCredential(l))
    /\ \A l \in Locks : WF_vars(ReleaseCredential(l))
    /\ WF_vars(IncreaseCapacity)

\* reclaimed in lockstep with capacity -- never created or destroyed.
CredentialsConserved == available + Cardinality(heldBy) = capacity

\* LIVENESS: every submitted request is eventually granted.
EveryRequestEventuallyGranted ==
    \A l \in Locks : (l \in waiting) ~> (l \in heldBy)

    /\ hubClaim \in Fitters \cup {Nobody}
    /\ slotClaim \in [Slots -> Fitters \cup {Nobody}]
    /\ programmed \in [Slots -> Guests \cup {Blank}]
    /\ code \in [Guests -> Slots \cup {NoCode}]
    /\ allowance \in 0..MaxAllowance

    /\ slotClaim = [s \in Slots |-> Nobody]
    /\ programmed = [s \in Slots |-> Blank]
    /\ code = [g \in Guests |-> NoCode]

    /\ hubClaim = Nobody
    /\ hubClaim' = f
    /\ UNCHANGED <<slotClaim, programmed, code, allowance>>

    /\ slotClaim[s] = Nobody
    /\ slotClaim' = [slotClaim EXCEPT ![s] = f]
    /\ UNCHANGED <<hubClaim, programmed, code, allowance>>

Programme(f, s, g) ==
    /\ slotClaim[s] = f
    /\ programmed[s] = Blank
    /\ code[g] = NoCode

    /\ UNCHANGED <<hubClaim, slotClaim, code, allowance>>

(* Library reservations with optimistic concurrency. A fixed number of book
   copies circulate among three buckets: available, reserved, and borrowed.
   A state transition is staged against a snapshot of the catalog revision and
   commits only if the revision has not moved; otherwise the client retries.
   Revision-sync messages may interleave arbitrarily. Copies only move between
   buckets, so their total is conserved. *)

Buckets == 1..3
Total == 3
None == 0
Mod == 4

vars == <<pool, revision, snap, pending, retries>>

TypeOK ==
    /\ pool \in [Buckets -> 0..Total]
    /\ revision \in 0..Mod-1
    /\ snap \in 0..Mod-1
    /\ pending \in {None, 1, 2, 3}
    /\ retries \in 0..Total

Init ==
    /\ pool = [b \in Buckets |-> IF b = 1 THEN Total ELSE 0]
    /\ revision = 0
    /\ snap = 0
    /\ pending = None
    /\ retries = 0

\* stage a move of kind k: 1 avail->reserved, 2 reserved->borrowed, 3 borrowed->avail
Begin(k) ==
    /\ pending = None
    /\ pending' = k
    /\ snap' = revision
    /\ UNCHANGED <<pool, revision, retries>>

Src(k) == IF k = 1 THEN 1 ELSE IF k = 2 THEN 2 ELSE 3
Dst(k) == IF k = 1 THEN 2 ELSE IF k = 2 THEN 3 ELSE 1

Commit ==
    /\ pending # None
    /\ snap = revision
    /\ pool[Src(pending)] > 0
    /\ pool' = [pool EXCEPT ![Src(pending)] = @ - 1, ![Dst(pending)] = @ + 1]
    /\ revision' = (revision + 1) % Mod
    /\ pending' = None
    /\ UNCHANGED <<snap, retries>>

Retry ==
    /\ pending # None
    /\ snap # revision
    /\ pending' = None
    /\ retries' = (retries + 1) % (Total + 1)
    /\ UNCHANGED <<pool, revision, snap>>

Sync ==
    /\ revision' = (revision + 1) % Mod
    /\ UNCHANGED <<pool, snap, pending, retries>>

    \/ \E k \in {1, 2, 3} : Begin(k)
    \/ Commit
    \/ Retry
    \/ Sync

Occupying(b) == { r \in Requests : target[r] = b /\ stage[r] \in {"prepared", "committed"} }

  /\ target \in [Requests -> Branches]
  /\ voted \in [Requests -> SUBSET Branches]
  /\ logged \subseteq Requests
  /\ offline \subseteq Branches

  /\ stage = [r \in Requests |-> "idle"]
  /\ target = [r \in Requests |-> HomeBranch]
  /\ voted = [r \in Requests |-> {}]

  /\ offline = {}

  /\ stage[r] = "idle"
  /\ stage' = [stage EXCEPT ![r] = "voting"]
  /\ target' = [target EXCEPT ![r] = b]
  /\ voted' = [voted EXCEPT ![r] = {}]
  /\ UNCHANGED <<logged, offline>>

  /\ stage[r] = "voting"
  /\ b \notin offline
  /\ b \notin voted[r]
  /\ voted' = [voted EXCEPT ![r] = voted[r] \cup {b}]
  /\ UNCHANGED <<stage, target, logged, offline>>

  /\ stage[r] = "voting"
  /\ Branches \ offline \subseteq voted[r]
  /\ Cardinality(Occupying(target[r])) < ShelfSpaces
  /\ stage' = [stage EXCEPT ![r] = "prepared"]
  /\ logged' = logged \cup {r}
  /\ UNCHANGED <<target, voted, offline>>

  /\ stage' = [r \in Requests |->

  /\ UNCHANGED <<stage, target, voted, logged>>

---------------------------- MODULE W4Od19m3p2t4 ----------------------------
EXTENDS Naturals

CONSTANTS Servers, Total, MaxTerm, MaxCap

ASSUME Total \in Nat /\ Total >= 1
ASSUME MaxTerm \in Nat /\ MaxTerm >= 1
ASSUME MaxCap \in Nat /\ MaxCap >= 1

None == "none"

VARIABLES
    shelf,     \* books on the shelf
    loaned,    \* books currently loaned
    leader,    \* the elected leader server, or None
    term,      \* current leadership term (mod MaxTerm+1)
    capacity   \* current loan capacity (changes at runtime)

vars == << shelf, loaned, leader, term, capacity >>

TypeOK ==
    /\ shelf \in 0..Total
    /\ loaned \in 0..Total
    /\ leader \in Servers \cup {None}
    /\ term \in 0..MaxTerm
    /\ capacity \in 0..MaxCap

Init ==
    /\ shelf = Total
    /\ loaned = 0
    /\ leader = None
    /\ term = 0
    /\ capacity = MaxCap

\* Elect a leader server for a fresh term while leadership is vacant.
Elect(s) ==
    /\ leader = None
    /\ leader' = s
    /\ term' = (term + 1) % (MaxTerm + 1)
    /\ UNCHANGED << shelf, loaned, capacity >>

\* The leader loans a book from shelf to loaned while below capacity.
Loan(s) ==
    /\ leader = s
    /\ shelf > 0
    /\ loaned < capacity
    /\ shelf' = shelf - 1
    /\ loaned' = loaned + 1
    /\ UNCHANGED << leader, term, capacity >>

\* The leader returns a book from loaned to shelf.
Return(s) ==
    /\ leader = s
    /\ loaned > 0
    /\ loaned' = loaned - 1
    /\ shelf' = shelf + 1
    /\ UNCHANGED << leader, term, capacity >>

\* The leader steps down, vacating leadership.
FailLeader(s) ==
    /\ leader = s
    /\ leader' = None
    /\ UNCHANGED << shelf, loaned, term, capacity >>

\* The loan capacity changes at runtime.
CapacityChange(c) ==
    /\ c # capacity
    /\ capacity' = c
    /\ UNCHANGED << shelf, loaned, leader, term >>

Next ==
    \/ \E s \in Servers : Elect(s)
    \/ \E s \in Servers : Loan(s)
    \/ \E s \in Servers : Return(s)
    \/ \E s \in Servers : FailLeader(s)
    \/ \E c \in 0..MaxCap : CapacityChange(c)

Spec == Init /\ [][Next]_vars

\* Books are conserved: shelf plus loaned always equals the starting count.
Conservation ==
    shelf + loaned = Total

=============================================================================

\* lockReg is the compare-and-swap lock register guarding the shared reservation
\* ledger (the critical resource). Workers belong to two independent reservation
\* instances (A*, B*) that share the one ledger. pc[w] tracks each worker.
Init ==
    /\ lockReg = NONE
    /\ pc = [w \in Workers |-> "idle"]
    /\ ledger = 0
    /\ pending = {}

\* A worker submits a compare-and-swap acquire against the lock, expecting it free.
Submit(w) ==
    /\ pc[w] = "idle"
    /\ ~ \E r \in pending : r.worker = w
    /\ pending' = pending \cup {[worker |-> w, exp |-> NONE]}
    /\ UNCHANGED <<lockReg, pc, ledger>>

\* CAS succeeds only if the register still equals the expected (free) value; the
\* winner takes the lock and enters the critical section.
ApplyCAS(r) ==
    /\ r \in pending
    /\ lockReg = r.exp
    /\ lockReg' = r.worker
    /\ pc' = [pc EXCEPT ![r.worker] = "cs"]
    /\ pending' = pending \ {r}
    /\ UNCHANGED ledger

\* CAS fails: the lock was taken by someone else, so the request is dropped and
\* the worker will retry.
FailCAS(r) ==

    /\ lockReg # r.exp

--------------------------- MODULE W4Od19m8p6t1 ---------------------------
(* Library book reservation with hierarchical locks. To reserve a book a
   patron must first hold the coarse lock on the book's shelf, then the fine
   lock on the book itself. Reservation requests travel over a queue that may
   reorder them. A patron's borrowing privileges can be revoked; a revoked
   (stale) patron must not retain any book lock. *)
EXTENDS Naturals, FiniteSets

CONSTANTS Patrons, None
Books == 1..3
Shelves == 1..2
ShelfOf(b) == IF b = 3 THEN 2 ELSE 1
Holder == Patrons \cup {None}

VARIABLES coarse, fine, revoked, requests, authority

vars == <<coarse, fine, revoked, requests, authority>>

TypeOK ==
    /\ coarse \in [Shelves -> Holder]
    /\ fine \in [Books -> Holder]
    /\ revoked \in SUBSET Patrons
    /\ requests \in SUBSET (Patrons \X Books)
    /\ authority \in 0..3

Init ==
    /\ coarse = [s \in Shelves |-> None]
    /\ fine = [b \in Books |-> None]
    /\ revoked = {}
    /\ requests = {}
    /\ authority = 0

Request(p, b) ==
    /\ p \notin revoked
    /\ <<p, b>> \notin requests
    /\ requests' = requests \cup {<<p, b>>}
    /\ UNCHANGED <<coarse, fine, revoked, authority>>

AcquireShelf(p, s) ==
    /\ p \notin revoked
    /\ coarse[s] = None
    /\ coarse' = [coarse EXCEPT ![s] = p]
    /\ UNCHANGED <<fine, revoked, requests, authority>>

Grant(p, b) ==
    /\ <<p, b>> \in requests
    /\ p \notin revoked
    /\ coarse[ShelfOf(b)] = p
    /\ fine[b] = None
    /\ fine' = [fine EXCEPT ![b] = p]
    /\ requests' = requests \ {<<p, b>>}
    /\ UNCHANGED <<coarse, revoked, authority>>

Revoke(p) ==
    /\ p \notin revoked
    /\ revoked' = revoked \cup {p}
    /\ coarse' = [s \in Shelves |-> IF coarse[s] = p THEN None ELSE coarse[s]]
    /\ fine' = [b \in Books |-> IF fine[b] = p THEN None ELSE fine[b]]
    /\ requests' = {r \in requests : r[1] # p}
    /\ authority' = (authority + 1) % 4

Reinstate(p) ==
    /\ p \in revoked
    /\ revoked' = revoked \ {p}
    /\ UNCHANGED <<coarse, fine, requests, authority>>

Next ==
    \/ \E p \in Patrons, b \in Books : Request(p, b)
    \/ \E p \in Patrons, s \in Shelves : AcquireShelf(p, s)
    \/ \E p \in Patrons, b \in Books : Grant(p, b)
    \/ \E p \in Patrons : Revoke(p)
    \/ \E p \in Patrons : Reinstate(p)

Spec == Init /\ [][Next]_vars

NoStaleHold ==
    \A b \in Books : fine[b] # None => fine[b] \notin revoked

EXTENDS Naturals, Sequences

CONSTANTS Robots, Schedulers, QCap

VARIABLES
    queue,     \* shared bounded intake queue of robots awaiting the charging bay
    pending,   \* pending[s]: robot scheduler s has pulled from the queue, or None
    owner,     \* the scheduler currently holding the single charging controller
    cs         \* cs[s]: TRUE while scheduler s is actively charging its robot

None == "none"

QHas(r) == \E i \in DOMAIN queue : queue[i] = r
HeldSomewhere(r) == \E s \in Schedulers : pending[s] = r

TypeOK ==
    /\ queue \in Seq(Robots)
    /\ Len(queue) <= QCap
    /\ pending \in [Schedulers -> Robots \cup {None}]
    /\ owner \in Schedulers \cup {None}
    /\ cs \in [Schedulers -> BOOLEAN]

Init ==
    /\ queue = << >>
    /\ pending = [s \in Schedulers |-> None]
    /\ owner = None
    /\ cs = [s \in Schedulers |-> FALSE]

\* Backpressure: a robot may enter the intake queue only when it is below cap.
Arrive(r) ==
    /\ Len(queue) < QCap
    /\ ~QHas(r)
    /\ ~HeldSomewhere(r)
    /\ queue' = Append(queue, r)
    /\ UNCHANGED <<pending, owner, cs>>

\* Either scheduler may pull the head of the shared queue when it has no robot.
Claim(s) ==
    /\ pending[s] = None
    /\ queue # << >>
    /\ pending' = [pending EXCEPT ![s] = Head(queue)]
    /\ queue' = Tail(queue)
    /\ UNCHANGED <<owner, cs>>

\* Acquiring the charging controller is the critical section.
Enter(s) ==
    /\ pending[s] # None
    /\ ~cs[s]
    /\ owner = None
    /\ owner' = s
    /\ cs' = [cs EXCEPT ![s] = TRUE]
    /\ UNCHANGED <<queue, pending>>

Leave(s) ==
    /\ cs[s]
    /\ cs' = [cs EXCEPT ![s] = FALSE]
    /\ owner' = None
    /\ pending' = [pending EXCEPT ![s] = None]
    /\ UNCHANGED <<queue>>

Next ==
    \/ \E r \in Robots : Arrive(r)
    \/ \E s \in Schedulers : Claim(s)
    \/ \E s \in Schedulers : Enter(s)
    \/ \E s \in Schedulers : Leave(s)

\* charging must be the one recorded as holding the controller, so the two
\* independent schedulers can never both drive the single bay at once.

---- MODULE W4Od3m3p0t3 ----
EXTENDS Naturals, FiniteSets

CONSTANTS Nodes, MaxTerm, MaxEntries, NoOne

VARIABLES leader, term, inside, nominee, stoodAside, posted

vars == <<leader, term, inside, nominee, stoodAside, posted>>

TypeOK ==
    /\ leader \in Nodes
    /\ term \in 1..MaxTerm
    /\ inside \in SUBSET Nodes
    /\ nominee \in {NoOne} \cup Nodes
    /\ stoodAside \in BOOLEAN
    /\ posted \in 0..MaxEntries

Init ==
    /\ leader \in Nodes
    /\ term = 1
    /\ inside = {}
    /\ nominee = NoOne
    /\ stoodAside = FALSE
    /\ posted = 0

\* A nomination closes the window to new entries; nothing is yanked away from
\* whoever is already in there.
Enter(n) ==
    /\ n = leader
    /\ nominee = NoOne
    /\ n \notin inside
    /\ inside' = inside \cup {n}
    /\ UNCHANGED <<leader, term, nominee, stoodAside, posted>>

Post(n) ==
    /\ n \in inside
    /\ posted < MaxEntries
    /\ posted' = posted + 1
    /\ UNCHANGED <<leader, term, inside, nominee, stoodAside>>

StepOut(n) ==
    /\ n \in inside
    /\ inside' = inside \ {n}
    /\ UNCHANGED <<leader, term, nominee, stoodAside, posted>>

Nominate(c) ==
    /\ nominee = NoOne
    /\ c # leader
    /\ term < MaxTerm
    /\ nominee' = c
    /\ stoodAside' = FALSE
    /\ UNCHANGED <<leader, term, inside, posted>>

\* Standing aside is the slow step: it may take as long as it likes, but the
\* incumbent has to be out of the window before it can happen.
StandAside ==
    /\ nominee # NoOne
    /\ ~stoodAside
    /\ leader \notin inside
    /\ stoodAside' = TRUE
    /\ UNCHANGED <<leader, term, inside, nominee, posted>>

Install ==
    /\ nominee # NoOne
    /\ stoodAside
    /\ leader' = nominee
    /\ term' = term + 1
    /\ nominee' = NoOne
    /\ stoodAside' = FALSE
    /\ UNCHANGED <<inside, posted>>

Restart ==
    /\ term = MaxTerm
    /\ nominee = NoOne
    /\ term' = 1
    /\ UNCHANGED <<leader, inside, nominee, stoodAside, posted>>

Leaving == \E n \in Nodes : StepOut(n)

Next ==
    \/ \E n \in Nodes : Enter(n) \/ Post(n)
    \/ Leaving
    \/ \E c \in Nodes : Nominate(c)
    \/ StandAside
    \/ Install
    \/ Restart

Spec == Init /\ [][Next]_vars
        /\ WF_vars(Leaving) /\ WF_vars(StandAside) /\ WF_vars(Install)

OnlyLeaderInWindow == \A n \in Nodes : n \in inside => n = leader

EveryNominationResolves == (nominee # NoOne) ~> (nominee = NoOne)

---- MODULE W4Od3m3p1t4 ----
EXTENDS Naturals, FiniteSets

CONSTANTS Coordinators, InitLeader, Updates, MinCapacity, MaxCapacity, InitCapacity

\* Optimistic-concurrency settlement record: baseVersion[u] is the version an
\* instruction read at Prepare time (0 = holding no snapshot); commitVersion[u]
\* is the version it wrote at Commit time (0 = never committed). Commit writes
\* the *stale-checked* snapshot into recordVersion, so if the CAS guard were
\* ever bypassed a superseded write could regress recordVersion below an
\* already-recorded commitVersion -- exactly the lost-update failure
\* NoLostUpdates below is meant to catch. Failover/capacity changes never
\* touch baseVersion or commitVersion, by design.
VARIABLES leader, recordVersion, capacity, baseVersion, commitVersion

TypeOK == leader \in Coordinators /\ recordVersion \in Nat
          /\ capacity \in MinCapacity..MaxCapacity
          /\ baseVersion \in [Updates -> Nat] /\ commitVersion \in [Updates -> Nat]

Init == leader = InitLeader /\ recordVersion = 0 /\ capacity = InitCapacity
        /\ baseVersion = [u \in Updates |-> 0]
        /\ commitVersion = [u \in Updates |-> 0]

\* Snapshot the record's version, bounded by the live capacity.
Prepare(u) == commitVersion[u] = 0 /\ baseVersion[u] = 0
              /\ Cardinality({x \in Updates : baseVersion[x] # 0}) < capacity
              /\ baseVersion' = [baseVersion EXCEPT ![u] = recordVersion + 1]
              /\ UNCHANGED <<leader, recordVersion, capacity, commitVersion>>

\* CAS guard: only a snapshot that is still exactly current+1 may commit,
\* and it writes its own (checked, non-stale) value into recordVersion.
Commit(u) == baseVersion[u] = recordVersion + 1 /\ commitVersion[u] = 0
             /\ recordVersion' = baseVersion[u]
             /\ commitVersion' = [commitVersion EXCEPT ![u] = baseVersion[u]]
             /\ baseVersion' = [baseVersion EXCEPT ![u] = 0]
             /\ UNCHANGED <<leader, capacity>>

\* A stale snapshot (someone else committed meanwhile) is discarded, not
\* applied, so the instruction can retry with a fresh read later.
Abort(u) == baseVersion[u] # 0 /\ baseVersion[u] # recordVersion + 1
            / commitVersion[u] = 0
            /\ baseVersion' = [baseVersion EXCEPT ![u] = 0]
            /\ UNCHANGED <<leader, recordVersion, capacity, commitVersion>>

\* Leadership moves; the optimistic guard never depends on who is leader.
Failover(l) == l # leader /\ leader' = l
               /\ UNCHANGED <<recordVersion, capacity, baseVersion, commitVersion>>

CapacityUp == capacity < MaxCapacity /\ capacity' = capacity + 1
              /\ UNCHANGED <<leader, recordVersion, baseVersion, commitVersion>>

CapacityDown == capacity > MinCapacity /\ capacity' = capacity - 1
                /\ UNCHANGED <<leader, recordVersion, baseVersion, commitVersion>>

\* Voluntary withdrawal: unlike Abort (which discards a snapshot that has
\* already gone stale), Withdraw lets an instruction give up a snapshot
\* that is still perfectly fresh (baseVersion[u] = recordVersion + 1) --
\* e.g. a business decision to cancel the settlement before committing it.
\* Its guard is the exact complement of Abort's staleness guard, so the
\* two can never both apply to the same instruction at once.
Withdraw(u) == baseVersion[u] = recordVersion + 1 /\ commitVersion[u] = 0
               /\ baseVersion' = [baseVersion EXCEPT ![u] = 0]
               /\ UNCHANGED <<leader, recordVersion, capacity, commitVersion>>

Next == (\E u \in Updates: Prepare(u)) \/ (\E u \in Updates: Commit(u))
        \/ (\E u \in Updates: Abort(u)) \/ (\E u \in Updates: Withdraw(u))
        \/ (\E l \in Coordinators: Failover(l))
        \/ CapacityUp \/ CapacityDown

vars == <<leader, recordVersion, capacity, baseVersion, commitVersion>>

Spec == Init /\ [][Next]_vars

\* No lost updates: an instruction's own recorded commit version can never
\* be stranded ahead of the record's current version -- if a stale write
\* had ever been let through, it would regress recordVersion below some
\* earlier commitVersion, tripping this.
NoLostUpdates == \A u \in Updates: commitVersion[u] # 0 => commitVersion[u] <= recordVersion

---- MODULE W4Od3m4p0t4 ----
EXTENDS Naturals, Sequences

CONSTANTS Batches, MinDepth, MaxDepth, IDLE

\* window: the one batch the posting engine currently has open, if any.
\* depth: the intake queue's admission limit, retuned by the ops desk.
VARIABLES queue, state, window, depth

vars == <<queue, state, window, depth>>

Stages == {"fresh", "queued", "posting", "posted", "refused"}

TypeOK ==
    /\ queue \in Seq(Batches)
    /\ state \in [Batches -> Stages]
    /\ window \in Batches \cup {IDLE}
    /\ depth \in MinDepth..MaxDepth

Init ==
    /\ queue = <<>>
    /\ state = [b \in Batches |-> "fresh"]
    /\ window = IDLE
    /\ depth = MinDepth

Admit(b) ==
    /\ state[b] = "fresh"
    /\ Len(queue) < depth
    /\ queue' = Append(queue, b)
    /\ state' = [state EXCEPT ![b] = "queued"]
    /\ UNCHANGED <<window, depth>>

\* Backpressure: at the limit the batch is refused, never quietly buffered.
Refuse(b) ==
    /\ state[b] = "fresh"
    /\ Len(queue) >= depth
    /\ state' = [state EXCEPT ![b] = "refused"]
    /\ UNCHANGED <<queue, window, depth>>

Represent(b) ==
    /\ state[b] = "refused"
    /\ state' = [state EXCEPT ![b] = "fresh"]
    /\ UNCHANGED <<queue, window, depth>>

\* The engine takes strictly the oldest queued batch, so nobody is overtaken.
Begin ==
    /\ window = IDLE
    /\ queue # <<>>
    /\ window' = Head(queue)
    /\ state' = [state EXCEPT ![Head(queue)] = "posting"]
    /\ queue' = Tail(queue)
    /\ UNCHANGED depth

Complete ==
    /\ window # IDLE
    /\ state' = [state EXCEPT ![window] = "posted"]
    /\ window' = IDLE
    /\ UNCHANGED <<queue, depth>>

Retune ==
    /\ \E n \in MinDepth..MaxDepth : depth' = n
    /\ UNCHANGED <<queue, state, window>>

Next ==
    \/ \E b \in Batches : Admit(b) \/ Refuse(b) \/ Represent(b)
    \/ Begin \/ Complete \/ Retune

Spec == Init /\ [][Next]_vars /\ WF_vars(Begin) /\ WF_vars(Complete)

PostingIsTheOpenWindow ==
    \A b \in Batches : state[b] = "posting" => window = b

AdmittedBatchesGetPosted ==
    \A b \in Batches : (state[b] = "queued") ~> (state[b] = "posted")

\* Banks in an interbank settlement batch must take turns holding exclusive
\* access to the shared settlement ledger (the critical resource) so that
\* net positions are computed without interference. Access is granted not by
\* a lock but by quorum voting: a requester needs pledges from enough banks
\* (Quorum of them, counting itself) before it may enter. Because a bank can
\* be slow to respond but never fails outright, a pledge it is still sitting
\* on can be reclaimed by an older, higher-priority request (Preempt) so that
\* a slow voter can never permanently stall someone else's progress.
