---------------------------- MODULE W4Od3m5p1t3 ----------------------------
(* Interbank settlement ledger updated by quorum-approved writes. A bank stages
   a write against a snapshot of the ledger and gathers a quorum of approvals;
   the write commits only if the ledger still equals its snapshot, so a bank
   whose snapshot went stale (a rival committed first) must retry instead of
   overwriting. Banks may be slow to vote but never fail. The ledger value
   always equals the number of applied writes. *)
EXTENDS Naturals, FiniteSets

CONSTANTS Banks, Voters
Quorum == 2
MaxV == 2

VARIABLES ledger, applied, snap, staged, votes

vars == <<ledger, applied, snap, staged, votes>>

TypeOK ==
    /\ ledger \in 0..MaxV
    /\ applied \in 0..MaxV
    /\ snap \in [Banks -> 0..MaxV]
    /\ staged \in [Banks -> BOOLEAN]
    /\ votes \in [Banks -> SUBSET Voters]

Init ==
    /\ ledger = 0
    /\ applied = 0
    /\ snap = [b \in Banks |-> 0]
    /\ staged = [b \in Banks |-> FALSE]
    /\ votes = [b \in Banks |-> {}]

Stage(b) ==
    /\ ~staged[b]
    /\ staged' = [staged EXCEPT ![b] = TRUE]
    /\ snap' = [snap EXCEPT ![b] = ledger]
    /\ votes' = [votes EXCEPT ![b] = {}]
    /\ UNCHANGED <<ledger, applied>>

Vote(b, w) ==
    /\ staged[b]
    /\ w \notin votes[b]
    /\ votes' = [votes EXCEPT ![b] = @ \cup {w}]
    /\ UNCHANGED <<ledger, applied, snap, staged>>

Commit(b) ==
    /\ staged[b]
    /\ Cardinality(votes[b]) >= Quorum
    /\ snap[b] = ledger
    /\ ledger < MaxV
    /\ ledger' = snap[b] + 1
    /\ applied' = applied + 1
    /\ staged' = [staged EXCEPT ![b] = FALSE]
    /\ UNCHANGED <<snap, votes>>

Retry(b) ==
    /\ staged[b]
    /\ snap[b] # ledger
    /\ staged' = [staged EXCEPT ![b] = FALSE]
    /\ UNCHANGED <<ledger, applied, snap, votes>>

Abort(b) ==
    /\ staged[b]
    /\ staged' = [staged EXCEPT ![b] = FALSE]
    /\ UNCHANGED <<ledger, applied, snap, votes>>

Compact ==
    /\ ledger = MaxV
    /\ \A b \in Banks : ~staged[b]
    /\ ledger' = 0
    /\ applied' = 0
    /\ UNCHANGED <<snap, staged, votes>>

Next ==
    \/ \E b \in Banks : Stage(b)
    \/ \E b \in Banks, w \in Voters : Vote(b, w)
    \/ \E b \in Banks : Commit(b)
    \/ \E b \in Banks : Retry(b)
    \/ \E b \in Banks : Abort(b)
    \/ Compact

Spec == Init /\ [][Next]_vars

NoLostUpdate == ledger = applied

---- MODULE W4Od3m6p6t3 ----
EXTENDS Naturals

(* A bank's interbank settlement batch grants a lease (with expiry via timeout)   *)
(* to one participant at a time.  Each grant is stamped with a fresh lease         *)
(* sequence number, and the current holder always carries the latest sequence.     *)
(* Only the holder of a valid (un-timed-out) lease may settle.  A participant may   *)
(* be slow -- its lease can time out -- but it never fails and may re-acquire.      *)

CONSTANTS MaxSeq, MaxSettle

Parts == {"p1", "p2", "p3"}
NoOne == "none"

VARIABLES holder, holderSeq, leaseSeq, active, settled

vars == << holder, holderSeq, leaseSeq, active, settled >>

TypeOK ==
    /\ holder \in Parts \cup {NoOne}
    /\ holderSeq \in 0..MaxSeq
    /\ leaseSeq \in 0..MaxSeq
    /\ active \in BOOLEAN
    /\ settled \in 0..MaxSettle

Init ==
    /\ holder = NoOne
    /\ holderSeq = 0
    /\ leaseSeq = 0
    /\ active = FALSE
    /\ settled = 0

\* Grant the lease when free or timed out; stamp the current lease sequence.
Acquire(p) ==
    /\ (holder = NoOne \/ ~active)
    /\ leaseSeq' = IF leaseSeq < MaxSeq THEN leaseSeq + 1 ELSE leaseSeq
    /\ holder' = p
    /\ holderSeq' = (IF leaseSeq < MaxSeq THEN leaseSeq + 1 ELSE leaseSeq)
    /\ active' = TRUE
    /\ UNCHANGED settled

\* The lease times out (expiry); the holder becomes stale until it re-acquires.
Timeout ==
    /\ holder # NoOne
    /\ active
    /\ active' = FALSE
    /\ UNCHANGED << holder, holderSeq, leaseSeq, settled >>

Release(p) ==
    /\ holder = p
    /\ holder' = NoOne
    /\ active' = FALSE
    /\ UNCHANGED << holderSeq, leaseSeq, settled >>

\* Only the holder of a valid, current-sequence lease may settle.
Settle(p) ==
    /\ holder = p
    /\ active
    /\ holderSeq = leaseSeq
    /\ settled < MaxSettle
    /\ settled' = settled + 1
    /\ UNCHANGED << holder, holderSeq, leaseSeq, active >>

Next ==
    \/ \E p \in Parts : Acquire(p)
    \/ Timeout
    \/ \E p \in Parts : Release(p)
    \/ \E p \in Parts : Settle(p)

Spec == Init /\ [][Next]_vars

(* No stale participant is ever treated as the valid holder: whenever there is a *)
(* holder, it carries the latest lease sequence number.                          *)
HolderIsCurrent == holder # NoOne => holderSeq = leaseSeq

    /\ tokenAtStart \in Players \cup {NULL}

---------------------------- MODULE W4Od5m7p3t3 ----------------------------
(* Multiplayer game lobby seating via a compare-and-swap register per seat.
   A player first tentatively reserves a free seat, then commits it by CAS-ing
   the owner register from Free to itself. A seat can be reserved only while it
   is unowned, so a seat is never tentatively reserved by one player while owned
   by another. Players may be slow between reserving and committing. *)
EXTENDS Naturals

CONSTANTS Players, Free
Seats == 1..2
MaxT == 2

VARIABLES owner, reserving, clock, served

vars == <<owner, reserving, clock, served>>

TypeOK ==
    /\ owner \in [Seats -> Players \cup {Free}]
    /\ reserving \in [Seats -> Players \cup {Free}]
    /\ clock \in 0..MaxT
    /\ served \in 0..6

Init ==
    /\ owner = [s \in Seats |-> Free]
    /\ reserving = [s \in Seats |-> Free]
    /\ clock = 0
    /\ served = 0

Reserve(p, s) ==
    /\ reserving[s] = Free
    /\ owner[s] = Free
    /\ reserving' = [reserving EXCEPT ![s] = p]
    /\ UNCHANGED <<owner, clock, served>>

Commit(p, s) ==
    /\ reserving[s] = p
    /\ owner[s] = Free
    /\ owner' = [owner EXCEPT ![s] = p]
    /\ served' = (served + 1) % 7
    /\ UNCHANGED <<reserving, clock>>

Release(p, s) ==
    /\ owner[s] = p
    /\ owner' = [owner EXCEPT ![s] = Free]
    /\ reserving' = [reserving EXCEPT ![s] = Free]
    /\ UNCHANGED <<clock, served>>

Abandon(p, s) ==
    /\ reserving[s] = p
    /\ owner[s] = Free
    /\ reserving' = [reserving EXCEPT ![s] = Free]
    /\ UNCHANGED <<owner, clock, served>>

Tick ==
    /\ clock < MaxT
    /\ clock' = clock + 1
    /\ UNCHANGED <<owner, reserving, served>>

Next ==
    \/ \E p \in Players, s \in Seats : Reserve(p, s)
    \/ \E p \in Players, s \in Seats : Commit(p, s)
    \/ \E p \in Players, s \in Seats : Release(p, s)
    \/ \E p \in Players, s \in Seats : Abandon(p, s)
    \/ Tick

Spec == Init /\ [][Next]_vars

NoDouble ==
    \A s \in Seats :
        (reserving[s] # Free /\ owner[s] # Free) => reserving[s] = owner[s]
============================================================================

\* network and may be delivered late -- a player can be slow, but is never lost:
\* every in-flight invite is eventually delivered. A player may take a seat in a
\* match only while holding a ticket stamped with the CURRENT lobby epoch, so a
\* slow player carrying a stale ticket is not authorised to be seated.
